title: Data Quality & Assurance Lead
description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

As a Data Quality & Assurance Lead, you will be responsible for driving overall program efficiency and effectiveness and the implementation of various techniques and tools to support data management efforts with business owners and technical teams. This role will support one or more information management functions in the following areas: Metadata management to ensure information is understood, Data Quality to ensure data is measured and trusted, Retention Management to ensure data is retained and purged appropriately, or Data Security to ensure data is properly secured and handled based on sensitivity and regulatory requirements. Key tasks include documentation data sources, facilitating Authoritative Data Source certification, managing metadata and data lineage within the Enterprise Data Repository, ensuring data quality, monitoring service level agreements (SLAs) and data quality metrics, and overseeing timely remediation efforts. The role also monitors significant changes to ensure timely re-certification.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX, Plano, TX, Phoenix, AZ, Colorado Springs, CO, or Charlotte, NC. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

What you'll do:

  • Assist IMA Director in ensuring that information management practices are integrated into appropriate business and technology processes in support of the Information Governance policy.

  • Identify and influence opportunities for process improvements across all IMA responsibilities and processes across data spokes.

  • Lead discussions with cross-functional teams on complex problems. Align best practices and tools based on business needs and driving the efficiency and effectiveness of the program.

  • Influence or assist with prioritization of work based on criticality and risk.

  • Influence others across business areas and levels to implement and enhance information solutions.

  • Responsible for the maintenance and validity of Information Asset Inventories.

  • Champion and support delivery of information in accordance with Information Governance standards and data management practices.

  • Lead the integration of Information Management practices into existing processes including ability to incorporate data management practices into new and emerging information technologies or complex situations.

  • Lead Data Lineage collection and stitching to ensure complete end to end data flow of critical data.

  • Lead the identification of and resolution of complex data quality concerns or issues.

  • Assist Steward in the design of data quality rules, thresholds, and standard metrics of quality for data elements that support critical business processes in complex situations.

  • Development of process enhancements to mitigate data quality risks including data quality plan development and overseeing the implementation of data quality controls.

  • Define and oversee high risk data quality corrective action plans.

  • Oversee compliance assessment process by reviewing and documenting failures from data quality compliance assessment checks.

  • Lead the implementation of Data initiatives within their data spoke that help mitigate data risk and perform root cause analysis to identify areas for improvement.

  • Influence others to implement and improve data quality practices.

  • Develop Master and Reference Data processes to align with Enterprise Policies and Standards.

  • Ensure quality and maintenance of master and reference data.

  • Oversee compliance assessment process by identifying and escalating items that may be a risk to the corporation.

  • Partner with IT and other Information Management resources to define and implement complex Access Management strategies in alignment with Information Governance policies.

  • Lead Privacy initiatives through classification and analysis of sensitive data.

  • Ensure compliance and remediation of sensitive data to ensure proper mitigation of inherent risk.

  • Identify and influence opportunities for process improvements across all IMA and/or Stewardship responsibilities and processes across data spokes.

  • Assist the Steward or if the Steward, design of data quality rules, thresholds, and standard metrics of quality for data elements that support critical business processes in complex situations.

  • Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What you have:

  • Bachelor's degree in a business or science field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience; and

  • 8+ years of experience in in an information management practice, business application function, or data delivery; OR If Advanced degree in a Business or Science discipline, 6 years of experience in data and analytics, technical, or business relevant function.

  • Demonstrated expertise to develop and implement of Strategies or Processes related to Information Management in complex situations.

  • Proven experience leading projects or programs in which you applied data management practices and tools to address data management risks and concerns during data lifecycle.

  • Advanced SQL knowledge including SQL-based languages.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead efforts of analysis and resolution of problems or issues; identifies when and how to escalate problems to the appropriate level.

  • Experience in synthesizing key information/data and research in order to recommend information management initiatives that meet business goals.

  • Experience leading project teams or support teams to define, redefine, or continue management of data.

  • Experience working in Agile Methodology.

  • Demonstrated expert communication skills with the ability to deliver presentations to all levels of management including concise presentation of complex technical details.

  • Indirect leadership of others to deliver results.

  • Demonstrated information management expertise including experience coaching and mentoring others on information management practices.

What sets you apart:

  • Financial services, insurance, banking, or other highly regulated industry experience.

  • CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) certification preferred.

  • US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner.

Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $164,780 - $314,960.

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer II
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

We believe that with the right mixture of tools and engineering prowess, we can secure our most important assets without negatively impacting productivity. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment where continuous learning and growth are encouraged.

Design and conduct offensive security operations / engagements for product and internal tools across Instacart. Deploy and operationalize a variety of open-source and commercially available security tools that can scale out and be maintained long term. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering and product, to integrate security testing into their SDLC cycle. Share knowledge and mentor other team members, promoting a culture of continuous learning and growth..

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience in mobile app penetration testing, AI security testing or cloud penetration testing

  • An ability to make data-driven decisions & prioritize initiatives that improve key security metrics
  • An ability to balance a sense of urgency with shipping high-quality and pragmatic solutions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or related work experience

Publishes and maintains ILARNG policy guidance on the Career Skills Program (CSP) for Title 32 AGR Soldiers separating from Active-Duty. (35%) Analyzes Department of Defense (DOD), Department of the Army (DA), National Guard Bureau (NGB), and state policies. May establish a State Retiree Council in-accordance with (IAW) AR 600-8-7 if directed by HRO. Reviews transactions and conducts transaction error resolution to help ensure retiree pay accounts are established on time. title: Founder's office
description:

Duties

  • Bachelor's degree in Kinesiology.
  • Current registration in good standing with the College of Kinesiologists of Ontario.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant clinical experience.
  • Current Basic Cardiac Life Support (BCLS) certification (Level C – Heart Saver Plus).
  • Demonstrated knowledge of rehabilitation principles and patient-centered care in an outpatient setting.
  • Strong assessment, clinical reasoning, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organizational, conflict resolution, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within an interdisciplinary team.
  • Ability and willingness to lead hydrotherapy sessions.
  • Openness to integrating cognitive-behavioural-therapy strategies, mindfulness, and/or relaxation techniques into the therapeutic approach an asset.
  • Openness to participating in research an asset.
  • Experience with chronic pain or chronic fatigue an asset.
  • Basic Cardiac Life Support (C Level) Heart Saver Plus Canada.
  • Knowledge of the rehabilitation approach to patient care in an outpatient setting.
  • Ability to lead hydrotherapy sessions in the pool.
  • Experience working with individuals living with chronic pain, chronic fatigue, and/or other complex disabilities.
  • Experience supporting patients with overlapping physical and mental health needs.

title: Principal AI Engineering Architect
description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Principal AI Engineering Architect, you will be tasked with leading the development and deployment of SentinelOne's next-generation AI-powered cybersecurity solutions. This critical role will shape SentinelOne's competitive advantage by translating cutting-edge AI research into production-grade, globally scalable products that proactively stay ahead of cybercriminals and tomorrow's threats. You will drive the strategy and execution for our core AI platforms, directly impacting our ability to deliver industry-leading protection to our customers.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Define and execute the technical roadmap for AI engineering, focusing on bringing the most recent advances in machine learning technology to help our customers efficiently discover and defeat threats.
  • Represent AI Engineering as a key contributor to the Architecture Board defining the overall architecture strategy for the SentinelOne Platform and Services.
  • Understand and define strategies to support cross domain requirements to use AI Platform and Services across SentinelOne.
  • Serve as a lead individual contributor who also mentors across distributed teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous innovation.
  • Design and build net-new AI capabilities to be used across SentinelOne's industry-leading cybersecurity platform.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across multiple engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and innovation in AI-powered cybersecurity products.
  • Oversee the establishment of best practices for MLOps, security, and performance monitoring to ensure the reliability and efficacy of our AI defense mechanisms.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 15 or more years of progressive experience in software or machine learning engineering.
  • Proven track record of delivering multiple high-scale, production-ready AI or data products from concept through deployment and maintenance.
  • Deep expertise in building highly available, low-latency machine learning systems, including experience with machine learning workflows and processes.
  • Experience in endpoint security, OS concepts, or a related field with comparable large-scale event processing and real-time processing challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, develop, and retain top-tier AI engineering talent.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Python and modern frameworks (e.g., Pydantic), cloud-native MLOps platforms (e.g., Kubeflow), and large-scale data processing technologies, including hands-on familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and operating in cloud environments, especially AWS and Google Cloud.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

title: Senior Mixed Signal Design Engineer

title: The CLIMA Fund Director of Programs & Learning
description:
Compensation and Benefits

Salary: $123,000

Location: Flexible / Remote position with a requirement to work 2-3 hours between 8AM and 12PM PST, at least four days per week (Monday–Friday)

Job Classification: Full time, Regular, Exempt

Reports to: Senior Director

Supervision Responsibilities: This position does not have supervision responsibilities

Travel Requirements: This position requires approximately 3-5 trips per year both in and outside of the U.S.

Start Date: January 4th, 2027

Application Deadline: August 31 by 5pm PT

The CLIMA Fund

The CLIMA Fund is a collaboration among Global Greengrants Fund, Grassroots International, Thousand Currents, Urgent Action Fund for Feminist Activism, and Youth Climate Justice Fund. The CLIMA Fund offers a way for large funders to efficiently and effectively reach grassroots work in over 160 countries. We holistically support climate movement-building, from rapid response for environmental defenders to long-term partnership and support to social movements. We partner with movements advancing food sovereignty, water and forest protection, gender justice, and Indigenous rights, recognizing that systemic transformation is led from the ground up.

Position Overview

The Director of Programs & Learning is responsible for strengthening CLIMA's programmatic collaboration through leading strategic initiatives and our learning structures. This role serves as a connector across member organizations, helping coordinate and facilitate the Learning and Evaluation Team and Programs Team. They will develop and lead organizational learning, and advance key initiatives and research that support our work influencing large climate philanthropies and visibilizing movement-led climate solutions.

The ideal candidate brings strong facilitation, learning, and strategic coordination skills, with an ability to translate insights into action and support collaboration across diverse people and organizational cultures. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable stewarding learning processes, coordinating initiatives, and supporting strategic planning.

Key Responsibilities

1. Programmatic Leadership & Initiative Coordination (Approximately 60% of the role)

  • Lead implementation and evolution of the Let It Flow Initiative, which is raising funds for grassroots-led watershed protection and restoration work in three pilot regions globally, including strategy development, partnership coordination, fundraising support, and learning and evaluation components.
  • Support implementation of the Democracy’s Immune System Initiative, including contributing to narrative materials, partnership engagement, and fundraising.
  • Support and lead development and implementation of emerging programmatic initiatives as relevant.
  • Ensure alignment between programmatic priorities and external communications and fundraising narratives by translating movement analysis and programmatic learning into compelling stories, evidence, and framing.
  • Facilitate and coordinate the cross-fund Programs Team, including supporting collective learning, identifying collaborative activities that can strengthen members’ respective work, and ensuring transparent communication.
  • Represent CLIMA in philanthropic and partner spaces as appropriate.

2. Learning, Evaluation & Research (Approximately 25% of the role)

  • Work closely with member organizations and Learning & Evaluation colleagues to synthesize lessons, emerging trends, and strategic implications for CLIMA's work.
  • Steward CLIMA's learning and evaluation processes, including evaluating CLIMA’s strategies and advancing our collective learning agenda.
  • Facilitate and coordinate the Learning and Evaluation Team.
  • Support development of impact frameworks and learning tools for initiatives, CLIMA’s influencing strategy, and CLIMA’s collective learning processes.
  • Manage ongoing research initiatives, including research on the mitigation impact of grassroots movements (e.g., Soil to Sky report series).

3. Collaborative Leadership & Facilitation (Approximately 15% of the role)

  • Support strategic planning and organizational reflection processes.
  • Identify areas to strengthen collaboration and communication across CLIMA's member organizations as needed.
  • Help steward organizational culture rooted in collaboration, equity, and care.
  • Bring programmatic insights and political analysis into organizational decision-making.

Candidate Profile

Experience and Competencies

  • At least 10 years of experience in climate justice, philanthropy, movement-building, organizational learning, or related fields, with direct experience partnering with grassroots climate justice movements.
  • Experience managing complex initiatives across organizations, networks, or collaborations.
  • Strong facilitation and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience designing learning and evaluation processes.
  • Outstanding communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills with an ability to prioritize, negotiate, and work with a variety of internal and external stakeholders and produce compelling written and digital materials
  • Strong understanding of climate justice, systems change, and movement-led approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinating across teams and geographies. Has the ability to stay on top of multiple projects: plans backwards, anticipates obstacles, identifies and involves stakeholders appropriately, and uses resources wisely.
  • Demonstrated success translating learnings into strategy and actionable initiatives from ideation to implementation.
  • Deep commitment to justice, equity, and solidarity practice.
  • Collaborative leadership style and comfort working across organizational boundaries.
  • Curiosity, humility, and a learning orientation.

Application Instructions

title: Junior Project Coordinator
location: UBC Hospital Site - Vancouver, BC, Canada
description:
Staff - Non Union

Job Category

Non Union Technicians and Research Assistants

Job Profile

Non Union Hourly - Research Assistant /Technician 4

Job Title

Junior Project Coordinator

Department

Moe Laboratory Research Support | Department of Emergency Medicine | Faculty of Medicine

Compensation Range

$33.09 - $38.82 CAD Hourly

Posting End Date

August 14, 2026

Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the Posting End Date.

Job End Date

December 31, 2026

This position is expected to be filled by promotion/reassignment and is included here to inform you of its vacancy at the University.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

Job Summary

The Junior Project Coordinator will primarily support a study evaluating emergency department (ED) peer support workers to support patients with substance use, managed through the UBC Department of Emergency Medicine. The incumbent will oversee all activities related to the planning, coordination, management, and timely completion of tasks related to the ED peer support worker study and evaluation, including patient and health care provider surveys, sharing circles, and focus groups, and assistance with analysis of process metrics and linked patient outcome data. Other responsibilities include implementing study protocols, monitoring study processes, and developing systematic methods for data collection. The Junior Project Coordinator will monitor study progress, produce reports, assist with financial management for research accounts, and ensure that standard operating procedures are followed to ensure quality control for the study.

Organizational Status

The vision of the UBC Department of Emergency Medicine is to be a provincially integrated Department committed to clinical and academic leadership in the creation and exchange of knowledge to promote excellence in emergency care. Our 600+ faculty members across the province have had an impressive record of research and discovery. Our research and innovation initiatives include 14 successful programs related to prevention of emergencies, improving clinical care, and system improvements. Our Emergency Medicine Royal College residency training program, distributed across 4 program sites, is the largest in the country. The Department of Emergency Medicine has also played a leadership role in the development and implementation of an Emergency Medicine Network across the province, designed to integrate and translate knowledge to support exceptional emergency care. It provides a rapid and effective avenue to exchange knowledge and experiences to support 1400 practitioners in 108 sites across the province.

The research program has earned Health Canada, Canadian Institutes of Health Research, and Canada Research Chair funding and is of interest to numerous provincial and national stakeholders. Substance and opioid use research is one of the key strategic initiatives of the UBC Department of Emergency Medicine. The research will focus on developing innovations to improve emergency department screening for patients with substance and opioid use disorders, identification of risk factors among these patients (including patterns and frequency of visits), treatment of overdose (e.g., naloxone and resuscitation approaches), and optimizing management and supports for emergency department patients at risk for overdose, including peer support workers and provision of buprenorphine/naloxone (standard dosing and microdosing).

This position reports directly to the Principal Investigator (PI), but the nature of the work requires independent action. The incumbent has frequent interaction and collaboration with other research team members and with external collaborators including policy makers, data custodians, patient advocates, people with lived experience with substance use, medical students, residents and healthcare professionals both within and outside the Department of Emergency Medicine to plan and conduct research, manage data, and analyze results.

Work Performed

Research Office Duties

  • Oversees all activities related to the ED peer support worker study, including planning, coordination, management, and timely completion of current and future study tasks.

  • Develops orientation presentations and training resources; including written materials such as task lists and FAQs, as well as written and verbal presentations, for the ED peer support worker study and other studies as needed. These resources focus on orienting staff to study procedures, expectations, and requirements.

  • Onboards, trains and supervises research assistants for the ED peer support worker study.

  • Monitors studies’ progress to ensure that deadlines are met (including reporting requirements), milestones achieved, and research is conducted in compliance with study procedures.

  • Ensures adherence to standard operating procedures and ensures quality control for ongoing studies.

  • Assists with site visits to train hospital and research staff on study protocols and ensure compliance with protocol.

  • Assists with management of research expenses, research accounts, payment of research expenses, preparing financial reports and budgets for all studies being undertaken.

  • Coordinates communication of research projects including informing relevant parties, ensuring study compliance and liaising with sponsor agencies.

Research Study Duties

  • Contributes to grant submissions by revising applications (which includes including performing literature searches, summarizing evidence, conducting reference checks), comparing materials to grant guidelines, and organizing co-investigator contributions.

  • Assists with editing reports and manuscripts, and preparing them for submission.

  • Oversees technical aspects of research studies including: patient screening and enrollment procedures, data collection, patient and healthcare provider survey, sharing circles, and focus group organization, planning, and implementation, liaising with hospital operations staff and leadership and community healthcare organizations, aggregating and summarizing results, and records management.

  • Promote the Emergency Substance and Opioid Use Program through email communication, newsletters, developing content for the webpage, social media and other methods.

  • Participates in research team meetings and rounds: sets agenda, prepares and presents financial reports, prepares and presents project updates, takes minutes.

  • Assists with Research Ethics Board (REB) applications, operational approvals, and submission of ongoing reporting requirements

  • Organizes hospital approvals for conducting research and grant applications.

  • Any other duties as required.

Consequence of Error/Judgement

The Junior Project Coordinator exercises professional judgment and initiative in the conduct of and in managing clinical research studies. Working closely with other members of the research team, the Junior Project Coordinator ensures that study procedures are performed consistent with the study protocol, applicable hospital procedures, ethical guidelines and regulatory policies. The Junior Project Coordinator is expected to work in a professional manner exercising poise and discretion especially when dealing with vulnerable patients and their families, and with sensitive medical information. Inappropriate disclosure of research participants' personal information would contravene privacy legislation and could result in legal action. Errors in data, reference materials or publications if detected, would result in delays, requiring additional resources to obtain or validate data. description:
Residential House Counselor – PRN

Youth Haven Services – Winston-Salem, North Carolina

Youth Haven Services is expanding its residential services in Winston-Salem, NC, and we are seeking dependable and compassionate PRN Residential House Counselors to join our team.

Our Residential Program serves clients in DSS custody and care who are in need of placement. The primary purpose of the home is to provide a safe, structured, and therapeutic environment while a long-term placement is secured.

This is a PRN/as-needed, on-call position. Individuals interested in PRN employment should have a flexible schedule and be available to work various shifts throughout the week, including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

If you are passionate about working with youth, providing support during times of transition, and helping create a safe and therapeutic environment for clients in our care, we encourage you to apply!

Position Summary

The Residential House Counselor provides direct care and rehabilitative services to clients in the residential program. This position provides behavioral modification interventions as outlined in each client's Person-Centered Plan and is responsible for promoting the overall safety, well-being, and welfare of clients.

Essential Job Duties

1. Skill Building – 35%

  • Provide clients with skill-building activities, including independent living skills, socialization, adaptation, and symptom monitoring/management skills.

  • Encourage clients to develop appropriate coping, communication, and daily living skills.

2. Therapeutic & Behavioral Support – 35%

  • Provide therapeutic mentoring, anger management, and social skills training.

  • Implement behavioral modification interventions as approved and outlined in the client's Person-Centered Plan.

  • Review client information and Person-Centered Plans to understand each individual's needs, limitations, strengths, and goals.

  • Promote a structured, supportive, and therapeutic environment.

3. Residential & Daily Living Responsibilities – 15%

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized residential environment.

  • Complete shift cleaning, meal preparation, and bed checks.

  • Transport clients as needed and necessary.

  • Assist with daily routines and activities within the residential setting.

4. Documentation & Records – 10%

  • Complete documentation regarding client progress in accordance with program guidelines and within required timeframes.

  • Maintain required client records and complete paperwork and other documentation as assigned.

5. Other Duties – 5%

  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned or required to support the residential program and the needs of clients.

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Experience

  • A minimum of two (2) years of documented experience working with the population served is preferred.

  • Experience working with children, adolescents, behavioral health, residential services, or other related human services settings is preferred.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • Knowledge of community resources and support services.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to use basic computer programs, including word processing and Excel.

  • Ability to utilize electronic documentation/e-notes systems.

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills.

  • Flexibility and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to develop productive and professional relationships with clients, families, and team members.

  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and make responsible decisions.

  • Ability to take direction and demonstrate initiative.

  • Ability to maintain appropriate professional boundaries.

  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.

  • Compassion, patience, dependability, and a commitment to supporting youth in a therapeutic environment.

Schedule

  • Availability may include day, evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts, based on program needs.

  • PRN staff may be contacted to provide coverage when regular staff are unavailable, or additional staffing support is needed.

Travel Requirements

title: Patient Navigator
description:
A bit about us:

Measured () is a modern weight care company. We believe that every person has the right to live a healthier and happier life, and that technology can help us get there. There are many weight care companies that have been around for decades and speak to a different generation. We're positioning ourselves to be the go-to solution for the next 25+ years.

Our solution takes an evidence-based approach to weight loss that is medically supervised and combines:

  • Personalized behavior change program administered via software. Our proprietary platform provides users with healthy recipes, customizable meal plans, educational courses, weekly goals and a number of tracking tools.

  • 1:1 and group coaching sessions by Registered Dietitians.

  • FDA-approved medication administered by licensed physicians via telehealth.

  • We're well funded and backed by Y Combinator and several other top-tier investors. We've got plenty of runway and are laser focused on building the absolute best product to help people effectively lose weight and keep it off.

This is a flexible, part-time contract (1099) role. We pay between $11.50-15.00 per hour depending on experience. We have a target of 16 hours per week spread across 2-4 days. We provide service 7 days per week from 9am-9pm EST, so there is plenty of flexibility with scheduling.

About the Role:

Measured is seeking experienced Patient Navigators to guide our patients through the onboarding process, support them in achieving their health goals, and ensure they have an exceptional experience with our program. The ideal candidate is a skilled problem-solver with a strong background in remote work environments, and a passion for helping others succeed on their health journeys.

What You'll Do:

  • Respond to patient emails and chats, ensuring all relevant information is accurately documented.

  • Establish and maintain a feedback loop between customers, the medical team, health coaches, and the care team to enhance the overall patient experience.

  • Identify customer concerns and resolve them promptly, collaborating with the appropriate teams as needed to ensure a quick resolution.

  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to recommend updates to product offerings, FAQs, services, and other resources.

  • Work cross-functionally to ensure that all inquiries and escalations are fully addressed within set timeframes.

  • Act as an advocate for our members, translating feedback and emerging trends into actionable insights for continuous improvement.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to increase operational efficiency and boost member satisfaction.

  • Consistently meet established SLAs and performance targets.

  • Perform other tasks and duties as assigned to support team and organizational goals.

About You:

  • You bring several years of experience in a medical setting, such as a Medical Receptionist, Medical Scribe, Customer Service, or Medical Assistant.

  • You're looking for a flexible work arrangement that allows you to contribute meaningfully from home.

  • You excel at supporting complex services and navigating challenging customer scenarios with empathy and professionalism.

  • You have strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with excellent typing and phone etiquette.

  • You're highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • You collaborate well with teams and enjoy being a part of a growing organization.

  • You are comfortable multitasking and adapting to change as the organization evolves.

  • You have experience with Helpscout, EHRs, or similar ticketing systems.

  • You are comfortable operating in a space with limited guidance and navigating situations that are new to you.

Why you Should Work with Measured:

  • Huge opportunity. Nearly half of all Americans have obesity and the numbers are only getting worse year after year. Consumers are spending a lot of money on this already for subpar products that don't work well. We have the ability to help a lot of people.

  • Challenging problems. We're in the business of changing human behavior, which is both fascinating and difficult. If you're into hacking complex systems or your own health, or have an interest in human psychology, you're going to love working on our product.

  • A great team. Our team is scrappy and experienced in building great products (Twice, UserTesting) and growing massive brands (BarkBox, Everlane). Everyone on our team comes from a social science educational background and we try to take a scientific, data-driven approach whenever possible.

  • Culture & diversity. Having worked at high growth, early stage startups in the past, our team understands the value of work-life balance. We take weekends off, go on vacations, and have quarterly team retreats. We’re a diverse team and believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences is what makes a strong team. The stronger our team, the closer we are to our mission.

  • Resources and growth. We're well capitalized with seed funding and are backed by Y Combinator and other top tier investors. We keep a lean team, and this is a rare opportunity to join us - you'll learn a lot, build cool products, and grow as our company scales!

title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk (3971)
description:
Under the supervision of the Logistics Supervisor, the Shipping & Receiving Clerk is responsible for receiving and storing material, supplies, and transporting raw materials and/or finished goods within shipping, receiving, and bindery departments. The Shipping & Receiving Clerk may also be called upon to assist the manager in other areas of the warehouse department.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This list of duties and responsibilities is not all‐inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

  • Verify materials received against purchase requisition. Receive product into inventory system.

  • Release material to production area.

  • Read job tickets to determine material needed, material location, and proper destination.

  • Transport materials and items from receiving or production areas to storage or other designated areas using a forklift or hand truck.

  • Maintain inventory records on computer system.

  • Periodically, take inventory of material and supplies in storage as assigned. Notify manager of low inventory supply

  • Wrap and prepare skids for shipment or return as necessary.

  • Load and Unload Trucks/Vans

  • Maintain warehouse; ensure neat and orderly storage of material.

  • Complete and maintain all required paperwork, records, documents, etc.

  • Follow and comply with all safety, work rules, and regulations.

  • Maintain departmental housekeeping standards.

  • Operate company vehicles to deliver or pick up product as needed (back‐up).

  • Back‐up to the Logistics Supervisor in the day‐to‐day operation of the department when required. These duties will include:

    • Coordinate Marek drivers for daily deliveries.

    • Reply to Emails from Sales/CSR Staff to coordinate deliveries, pickups and other shipping/receiving issues.

    • Prepare documents such as: Shipping schedules, Bills of Lading and shipping orders to route deliveries.

    • Contact Carrier Representatives to make arrangements for shipping and delivery of materials and finished goods.

    • Attend Production Meetings to go over the daily schedule to accomplish the delivery of all jobs due that day.

  • Other Duties and Responsibilities

    • Performs other duties as assigned.

    • Participates in proactive team efforts to achieve departmental and company goals.

    • Provides leadership to others through example and sharing of knowledge/skill.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Requires education generally equivalent to a high school diploma and one to three years of related experience.

  • Previous shipping, receiving and supervisory experience is desired.

  • Ability to use a computer to receive materials, record inventory moves, check inventory status, get shipping estimates and process shipments.

  • Ability to operate, load, and trouble‐shoot a pallet wrapper.

  • Ability to become certified to operate a sit‐down and stand‐up forklift.

  • Ability to lead others and delegate tasks as necessary

title: Supervisory IT Cybersecurity Specialist (INFOSEC)
description:
This position is located in the Vulnerability Management and Cyber Threat Emulation Branch (VMCEB), its main function is to prevent cyberattacks before they happen and determine how they happened when they do occur. This is performed through expertise in advanced intrusion detection, vulnerability management, and penetration testing. This position serves as the Vulnerability Management and Cyber Threat Emulation Branch Chief.

The physical worksite for this position is located in Alexandria, Virginia. Presence at the Alexandria, VA campus is required for this role, as it includes on site functions that must be performed in person. Position may be eligible for situational telework in accordance with agency policy/business unit discretion. The agency currently allows for 52 hours of telework per calendar year. Our team is excited to welcome you and your expertise if ... You are passionate and dedicated serving as Branch Chief, providing executive leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight for enterprise vulnerability management, cyber threat emulation, red team operations, threat hunting, attack surface management, and cybersecurity risk reduction activities. You are inspired and resilient directing the planning, execution, and continuous improvement of agency-wide vulnerability management programs designed to identify, assess, prioritize, remediate, and validate cybersecurity weaknesses across enterprise information systems, cloud services, applications, networks, and emerging technologies. You enjoy overseeing proactive threat hunting operations that leverage threat intelligence, behavioral analytics, forensic analysis, and cybersecurity telemetry to identify malicious activity, advanced threats, insider risks, and unauthorized activity before significant organizational impact occurs. You are excited developing policies, procedures, standards, and operational guidance supporting cyber defense, vulnerability management, threat hunting, adversary emulation, and continuous monitoring activities. You are a great leader, directing technical teams responsible for vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, cyber threat emulation, threat hunting, attack surface analysis, and cybersecurity engineering activities.

title: Social Worker (Program Coordinator)
description:
This Social Worker (Program Coordinator) position is in Physical Medicine and Rehab (PM&R) services at the VA Boston Healthcare Systems located at the Brockton location. This position is a full-time at 40 hours per week.

The purpose of this position is to serve as the Polytrauma Program Coordinator Social Worker at the VA Boston Healthcare System. The incumbent provides advanced clinical social work services while serving as the VISN 1 coordinator and subject matter expert for the Polytrauma System of Care. Duties may include, but are not limited to: Serve as the VISN 1 Polytrauma Program Coordinator and clinical subject matter expert for veterans and service members with traumatic brain injury (TBI) and polytrauma. Coordinate and oversee the delivery of comprehensive case management services across multiple VA medical centers and Community-Based Outpatient Clinics (CBOCs). Conduct biopsychosocial assessments, develop treatment plans, coordinate interdisciplinary care, and evaluate patient progress to ensure appropriate rehabilitation and community reintegration. Collaborate with physicians, nurses, psychologists, rehabilitation therapists, military treatment facilities, community partners, and other stakeholders to coordinate patient care and improve health outcomes. Provide consultation, education, and technical guidance to interdisciplinary teams regarding polytrauma, traumatic brain injury, rehabilitation services, and available VA and community resources. Lead multidisciplinary team meetings, facilitate case conferences, and coordinate communication among internal and external healthcare partners. Develop, implement, monitor, and evaluate program initiatives, performance measures, quality improvement activities, and compliance with national, VISN, and facility policies. Analyze program data, prepare reports, monitor outcomes, and recommend process improvements to enhance program effectiveness and patient care. Coordinate outreach, education, and resource development activities for veterans, families, healthcare providers, and community organizations. Mentor and provide clinical guidance to social workers and interdisciplinary staff regarding polytrauma case management and rehabilitation services. Maintain advanced knowledge of VA benefits, rehabilitation services, military culture, and community resources to support veterans and their families. Utilize electronic health records and VA information systems to document services, monitor patient outcomes, and maintain accurate clinical documentation. Perform other related duties as assigned.   • Support recruitment efforts
  • Provide business improvement methodologies and procedures.
  • Support staff performance and technical development with department leadership

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or closely related discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of relevant post education experience in the transmission engineering field managing projects and leading multi-disciplinary teams
  • Engineer license required (multi-state preferred)
  • Professional Engineering (PE) licensure.
  • Understanding of the NESC, RUS, and/or GO-95
  • Strong understanding of transmission line fundamentals and PLS-CADD operation
  • The candidate must have a strong command of the English language with good written and oral communication skills to work effectively with internal team members and external client personnel
  • Experience using the Microsoft Office software suite

  • Subcontractor management
  • Cost estimating and scheduling
  • Field experience
  • MBA degree from an accredited university
  • Involvement in technical societies (IEEE, CIGRE, ASCE…)
  • Experience using ArcGIS, AutoCAD/MicroStation, Foundation Design Software (FAD Tools, SHAFT, LPILE)
  • POLE and TOWER experience

title: Staff Software Engineer, Bazel & Go
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

OVERVIEW

The Developer Experience team at Instacart is the force multiplier for our 1000+ engineers. We define and build the platforms, tools, and practices that enable Instacart engineers to ship high-quality software faster — from AI-powered code review to build infrastructure, developer onboarding, and local development environments. Our success is measured in developer velocity: how quickly an engineer can take an idea from concept to production.

As a Staff Software Engineer on Developer Experience, you will lead two of the pillars that Instacart engineering is built on: Bazel (our build system) and Go (one of our core backend languages). You will own the technical direction for how thousands of daily builds run and how our Go services are structured, from remote build execution and caching to the frameworks, libraries, and patterns Go engineers use every day. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll write code, set architectural direction, and partner across the org to move engineering-wide metrics on build performance, CI reliability, and developer velocity.

About the Job

  • Lead the technical direction for Instacart's Bazel build system, including remote caching, remote build execution (RBE), build performance, and the developer-facing ergonomics of the build.
  • Lead the technical direction for our Go platform, frameworks, standard libraries, service scaffolding, and patterns that Go engineers across Instacart depend on.
  • Design and drive multi-quarter initiatives that measurably improve build times, CI reliability, and the local development loop for engineers working in Bazel and Go.
  • Own the developer experience metrics for the systems you lead, define what "good" looks like, instrument it, and use the data to prioritize investment.
  • Partner with infrastructure, platform, and product engineering teams to roll out changes to the build system and Go platform with minimal disruption.
  • Set the technical bar for the systems you own on reliability, performance, upgrade cadence, and developer ergonomics.
  • Mentor engineers in the team and the broader engineering org; grow the community of Bazel and Go experts at Instacart.
  • Represent the team in cross-org technical discussions on build, CI/CD, and backend platform direction.

About You

  • A hands-on technical leader who is equally comfortable in a Bazel BUILD file, a Go service, and a design doc.
  • Metrics-driven, You use build times, cache hit rates, CI reliability, and developer feedback to guide where to invest.
  • A multiplier. You make the engineers around you more effective through mentorship, clear technical writing, and pragmatic guidance.
  • Comfortable driving cross-team change. You can build consensus for a migration or a platform shift and see it through to adoption.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software development experience.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Bazel, including remote caching, remote build execution (RBE), and performance tuning of large build graphs.
  • Strong production experience writing and operating Go services at scale, with a point of view on structuring large Go codebases (frameworks, dependency management, testing patterns, shared libraries).
  • Track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives with measurable impact on developer velocity, build performance, or CI reliability.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and distributed systems.
  • Strong technical leadership, driving direction, mentoring engineers, and influencing without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience migrating a large codebase or monorepo to Bazel, or evolving an existing Bazel setup through major upgrades.
  • Experience owning or contributing to a Go framework, standard library, or service scaffolding used by a large engineering org.
  • Experience defining and instrumenting developer productivity metrics (build times, cache hit rates, CI reliability, local dev loop).
  • Experience at high-growth companies operating developer infrastructure for large engineering organizations.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Custody Services
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Custody Services team is responsible for managing our crypto infrastructure, digital asset custody providers, and the various integrations we maintain with third-parties — from wallet management to crypto infrastructure management! The team is also responsible for processing crypto transactions, as well as products like staking, lending, and travel rule compliance. We currently safeguard billions in assets under custody for millions of customers.

As a Senior Backend Engineer on this team, you'll work on the infrastructure behind crypto processing, wallet and key management workflows, and our integrations with third-party custodians. Most of what you'll build sits at the boundary between infrastructure and security.

This role is based in our London, UK office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs.

What you’ll do

  • Build and run the AWS infrastructure behind custody, key management, and blockchain node operations.

  • Automate infrastructure and configuration management (Ansible, Terraform, or similar) so the team spends less time on manual operations.

  • Run our blockchain nodes across the networks we support, and keep them healthy and available.

  • Write and maintain services in Python for infrastructure management and wallet operations.

  • Own the integrations with third-party custodians.

  • Build out Kubernetes and Docker deployments as we containerize more of the custody stack.

  • Set up monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent) so we know about problems before customers do.

  • Apply security controls and standards throughout — access control, key management, incident response.

  • Provide on-call support, responding to and resolving production issues to keep custody systems reliable and available.

What you bring

  • Senior-level experience running cloud infrastructure (AWS) in production.

  • Experience managing blockchain nodes in production.

  • Hands-on experience with Ansible, Terraform, or similar configuration management and Infrastructure as Code tooling.

  • Experience running containerized workloads on Kubernetes and Docker.

  • Solid Python and/or Go skills, with real production experience.

  • A strong security focus — you've worked on systems where key management and access control are critical.

  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, or an equivalent monitoring stack.

Bonus points

  • Experience integrating with third-party custodians like BitGo or Fireblocks — this is a key differentiator for this role.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership

  • Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs

  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not

  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.

  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!

  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

  • Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

title: IAM Security Engineer
description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

Join our team as an IAM Engineer and lead our next-generation detection, prevention, and automation strategies and models for enhanced identity, access management, governance, program management, and reporting capabilities. This is a game-changing role driving innovation with AI to proactively identify access patterns and mitigate policy violations and non-standard configurations before it impacts our organization.

You will innovate with AI by leading the development of advanced tools that summarize complex issues and recommend remediation plans, while continuously refining automated and manual administration while reducing the need for human intervention. You will build and deploy cutting-edge AI agents using platforms like Azure and Langchain, creating intelligent systems that can autonomously detect anomalous activities.

This position offers a unique opportunity to collaborate and lead cross-functional efforts with internal business and technical application owners, various lines of business within the organization, and governance and compliance teams by constantly evolving and maturing identity and access processes with the use of AI.

What you’ll be doing

  • Manage, configure, and optimize IAM solutions, including SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, Entra ID, and related identity governance tools to support secure and efficient access across enterprise systems.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve automation for IAM processes, including access provisioning, compliance reporting, role management, entitlement review, and routine administrative workflows.
  • Utilize and help develop AI-enabled capabilities to simplify IAM administration, support adaptive access decisions, identify anomalies or access risks, summarize access-related issues, and recommend remediation steps.
  • Build AI solutions that enhance IAM access administration, governance, hygiene, and program management functions. Utilize tools like Anthropic Claude, Copilot on Azure, and Langchain to create intelligent systems that can detect anomalous activities in a fully autonomous or semi-supervised fashion.
  • Lead the development of retrieval-augmented LLM tools to answer analyst requestor queries, auto-summarize issues information, and recommend next steps for access requests and/or access remediation. Continuously refine prompts and retrieval strategies for high precision in IAM and governance context.
  • Collaborate with the AI COE and AI Engineering team for best practices, technology, and AI support needs.
  • Use IAM data, reporting tools, and analytical methods to identify access trends, support KPIs and KRIs, improve access hygiene, and provide actionable insights for IAM and compliance stakeholders.
  • Utilize large datasets to develop access models and generate actionable insights. Focus on building AI agents without the need for deep expertise in based AI models
  • Support the development and refinement of rules, queries, reports, and AI-assisted methods that help detect non-standard access, policy violations, privileged access risks, or unusual access patterns.
  • Support provisioning, de-provisioning, access changes, and access review processes to ensure users, applications, and systems have appropriate access based on business need, role, and policy requirements.
  • Support IAM governance activities to help ensure alignment with internal policies, security standards, and regulatory frameworks such as HIPAA, SOX, SOC2, PCI-DSS, and related requirements.
  • Partner with Security, IT, application owners, business stakeholders, internal audit, and compliance teams to support consistent access management, policy enforcement, and process improvement.
  • Contribute to the ongoing maturity of IAM processes, tools, documentation, and controls by identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and strengthen security outcomes.

What you will need to be successful

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, cybersecurity, information security, or a related technical field.
  • Experience supporting enterprise IAM solutions, identity governance, access lifecycle management, and access control processes.
  • Experience with automation, scripting, data analysis, reporting, or AI-assisted workflow improvement.

Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Working knowledge of Generative AI, large language models, or AI-assisted tooling, especially as applied to access administration, governance, anomaly detection, reporting, or remediation support.
  • Experience with IAM and identity governance platforms such as SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, Entra ID, or similar tools.
  • Experience with privileged access management tools such as BeyondTrust or similar PAM solutions.
  • Understanding of Zero Trust security models and tools such as Silverfort or related access security technologies.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks related to IAM, such as SOX, HIPAA, SOC2, PCI-DSS, or similar standards.
  • Experience with cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and integrating IAM solutions with cloud services.
  • Ability to develop or support automation using tools, scripts, workflows, or reporting mechanisms to improve IAM operations.
  • Familiarity with Python, SQL, APIs, or similar technical methods for data analysis, reporting, automation, or IAM tool integration.
  • Ability to translate technical findings, access risks, and analytical results into clear, actionable recommendations.

Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or related IAM-focused certifications.

This is a remote position.

$96500.00 To $123000.00 / year

title: Security Vendor Specialist, NA
description:
About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Business Operations Department

As a part of the Vantage Operations team, the Business Operations department is responsible for ensuring standards for operation performance, maintaining customer leases, producing monthly customer electivity bills, generating regular reports, and supporting Operational Effectiveness. The Business Operations department also works closely with all Vantage departments to ensure customer success from the construction process through daily operations and delivery activities.

Position Overview

This is a Remote role.

The Security Vendor Specialist, North America plays a critical role in overseeing vendor onboarding, procurement workflows, contract management, financial tracking, and performance optimization across the region. This position ensures compliance with Third‑Party Risk Management (TPRM) requirements, supports Physical Security, Security Engineering, Construction, and New Site Development teams with Statements of Work (SOWs) and Purchase Orders (POs), and maintains accurate forecasting and reporting.

In addition, this role collaborates closely with operations leadership, OEMs, vendors, and contractors to improve the vendor experience, establish KPIs, support RFP development, and deliver consistent, high‑quality service outcomes. The Specialist resolves invoicing issues, facilitates vendor performance reviews, and helps drive operational efficiency and cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Vendor Onboarding & Compliance

  • Meet with prospective vendors to assess capabilities that enhance physical security or engineering performance.

  • Manage the end‑to‑end vendor onboarding process, including NDA execution, TPRM entry, and Master Agreement workflow in IronClad.

  • Maintain vendor onboarding trackers to monitor approval status and portfolio health.

  • Coordinate with Legal and Vendor Onboarding teams to finalize vendor entry into Yardi.

  • Create, validate, and maintain vendor contracts and new vendor setup documentation.

  • Ensure compliance with internal policies, security standards, and procurement guidelines.

Statements of Work (SOWs)

  • Draft and oversee SOWs for Physical Security, ensuring accurate workflow routing and approval in IronClad.

  • Create SOWs for Security Engineering teams, ensuring project number assignment and required approvals.

  • Develop SOWs for Construction teams when additional security support is needed.

  • Draft and manage SOWs for New Site Development, including SVRT report procurement.

Procurement & Financial Oversight

  • Apply for and manage POs for Physical Security Managers, Contractors, and Engineers.

  • Track POs by site and GL account, maintaining accurate spending forecasts across regions.

  • Build and maintain dashboards to support forecasting and budget planning using daily tracker data.

  • Ensure accurate year‑end accruals, PO closeouts, and timely invoice processing.

  • Match invoices to POs, code invoices accurately, and secure approvals through Finance systems.

  • Prepare and produce reports tracking vendor spend and project‑level financial health.

  • Support development of cost‑optimization strategies and make vendor recommendations based on performance metrics and cost analysis.

Vendor Relations & Performance Management

  • Serve as a primary relationship manager for assigned vendors, ensuring strong communication and timely issue resolution.

  • Conduct monthly or quarterly performance reviews to identify improvement opportunities for vendors and internal teams.

  • Establish and monitor KPIs for vendors; report performance trends to operations leadership.

  • Lead vendor work sessions to resolve invoicing discrepancies and improve operational efficiency.

  • Provide leadership with metrics and insights highlighting key performance trends, risks, and recommended actions.

  • Support the Vendor Relationship Manager in daily operations and long‑term program strategy.

Job Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in procurement, vendor management, or similar role.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Negotiation, vendor‑facing, and cross‑functional collaboration experience preferred.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; strong analytical and data interpretation skills required.

  • High ethical judgment, attention to detail, and accuracy in reporting.

  • Experience in data centers, high‑tech environments, or rapid‑growth industries strongly preferred.

  • Travel up to 5%, with potential to increase based on business needs.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
