The individual serves as the Deputy Assistant Commissioner (DAC) of Operations, Federal Acquisition Service (FAS), Office of Centralized Acquisition Service (OCAS) located in the General Services Administration (GSA). The Deputy Assistant Commissioner of Operations (DAC) is the primary advisor and chief operations officer to the Assistant Commissioner of OCAS, which is responsible for planning, managing, and directing the operational service centers consisting of systems, finance, service delivery and quality assurance. The executive provides strategic direction and operational oversight for these service centers. Additionally, the Deputy Assistant Commissioner: Serves the portfolio by directing all facets of operational mission within the areas consisting of business operations, finance, service delivery, systems, quality assurance and the success of the Office of Centralized Acquisition Services. Including leading, coordinating, communicating, integrating and is accountable for the overall business operational success of the program, ensuring alignment with critical agency priorities. Oversees and manages and aligns key functions of Quality Assurance, Systems, Service Delivery and Business Operations Service Centers to include the day-to-day operations of OCAS Operations Service Center directors and staff. Provides overall recommendations for the management of human, financial, material resources in support of OCAS goals and objectives. Serves as principal advocate for OCAS Operations. Prepares annual business plans outlining program objectives, strategies, goals, and resource requirements. Provides executive-level direction for all financial and performance analytics activities. This involves overseeing budget formulation, rate development, business model execution, and financial performance monitoring, while managing funding commitments and business volume forecasts. The executive leads enterprise-level performance analysis, business forecasting, and strategic case development to support informed decision-making across the portfolio. This responsibility includes establishing analytic governance practices to ensure accuracy, credibility, and consistency across intelligence outputs and coordinating the portfolio's input into agency-wide audits, accountable actions, internal controls, and related risk mitigation processes. Oversees portfolio strategy, planning, and external engagement. The individual provides strategic business guidance for mid- and long-range planning and ensures alignment of strategies with organizational goals. This role involves developing and applying portfolio management methods, managing standardization and efficiencies related to program and project management, and providing proactive decision support to portfolio executives. Leads enterprise-wide operational assessments to proactively identify systemic risks, shortfalls in productivity, and opportunities for process innovation, subsequently driving the implementation of integrated solutions to enhance organizational agility and performance. Cultivate and sustain strategic partnerships with key internal and external stakeholders across the agency to advance operational objectives. Leads inter-agency workgroups and collaborative initiatives, ensuring that OCAS operational strategies are effectively communicated and aligned with broader GSA and FAS mission requirements to drive organizational synergy.

OTHER CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT: This position is a Critical Sensitive national security position. Appointment to this position requires the selectee to undergo a background investigation and receive favorable adjudication for the GSA security office to grant you a Top Secret national security clearance. Applicants do not need this level of clearance in order to apply for the position. If you are not a GSA employee, the security office must grant the clearance before you are appointed to this position unless a pre-appointment waiver of this requirement is approved. This position has been designated under Executive Order 12564 as being subject to random drug screening. If tentatively selected for this position, you may be required to submit to a urinalysis screen for illegal drugs prior to appointment. Appointment will be contingent upon your receiving a negative test result. If tentatively selected, you will be required to submit a Declaration for Federal Employment. Male applicants born after December 31, 1959 will be required to complete a certification statement confirming their selective service status. Persons selected for their initial appointment to an SES position must have their executive qualifications approved by the Office of Personnel Management before being appointed to the position. If selected, you will be required to serve a one-year probationary period unless you have previously successfully completed a one-year probationary period in the Senior Executive Service. If selected, you must file a Public Financial Disclosure Report (OGE Form 278) upon appointment in accordance with the Ethics in Government Act of 1978. Veteran's preference does not apply to positions in the Senior Executive Service.

Spellman High Voltage Electronics Corporation, a family owned business for over 75 years, takes pride in powering progress in health, security and quality of life. We are key partners with the world’s leading medical devices, semiconductor, scientific analytics and industrial systems manufacturers. While Spellman is not a household name, our products are used to make and often power many of the most advanced technologies that make modern life possible. Spellman High Voltage Electronics Corp. is a leading and growing international company that delivers advanced products and solutions into the medical imaging, Non-Destructive Testing (NDT), Food Inspection and Transport Security markets at the global scale.

The position supports site leadership through the preparation of reports, tracking of metrics (KPI), creation of meeting materials and execution of special projects as assigned. As such, Spellman High Voltage Electronics Corp. is seeking a talented, motivated, and creative, and EHS&S Specialist.

  • Ensures appropriate corrective action is taken where environmental, health, safety, and security hazards exist.
  • Conduct ergonomic evaluations and EHS&S audits.

  • 3+ years of experience in a prior EHS role.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication, and presentation skills.
  • Basic understanding of EHS regulations and standards.

  • Prior internship or part time experience in EHS&S in a manufacturing environment preferred.

title: Lead Engineer – Separator Product Line
description:
Lead Engineer – Separator Product Line

Location: Chennai

Where Opportunity Knows No Borders
At Fuller Technologies, we’ve never been the ones to follow – we lead the way. For over 140 years, we’ve pioneered technologies, products, and services that make the cement industry cleaner, better, and more efficient—shaping the world as we know it today. From projects spanning the globe to solutions that maximise productivity, we continue to redefine what’s possible, always asking ourselves: What’s next?

When you join Fuller, you’re not just stepping into a job—you’re stepping into a career full of possibilities. Here, you’ll work with diverse teams across borders, tackle complex challenges, and make a tangible impact on transformative projects. With opportunities to travel internationally and exchange knowledge with industry leaders worldwide you’ll gain unique insights, expand your horizons, and grow both personally and professionally – shaping the future of an industry that itself shapes the world.

About the Role

The Lead Engineer – Separator Product Line provides global technical leadership and engineering expertise for the company’s separator product portfolio. Serving as the primary technical authority, this role owns the technical integrity and long-term development of separator products, supporting both current and legacy designs (including ROKSH, RARM, RAR-L, O-SEPA, and SEPAX).

The Lead Engineer is responsible for driving technical strategy across proposals, customer orders, aftermarket operations, product improvement initiatives, and long-term product road mapping. Key focus areas include product standardization, modularization, cost-reduction initiatives, innovation, and new aftermarket offerings. Operating in a cross-functional and global environment, this role collaborates closely with Sales, Project Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Field Service, and external customers to deliver reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective separator solutions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Global Technical Leadership: Act as the primary technical authority for the Separator product line, establishing engineering standards and supporting current and legacy equipment designs.
  • Product Roadmap & Lifecycle Management: Own and execute the technical product roadmap, leading initiatives focused on product innovation, design modifications, modularization, standardization, and cost-efficiency.
  • Proposal & Commercial Support: Partner with Sales, Proposal Management, and Commercial teams to review customer specifications, perform equipment selections, write technical proposals, and deliver cost-effective engineering solutions that support revenue objectives.
  • Engineering Execution & Quality: Lead technical execution across capital projects and engineered-to-order (ETO) applications, approving major design changes, validating calculations, and ensuring all engineering deliverables meet quality and safety standards.
  • Aftermarket & Field Support: Support aftermarket growth by developing technical solutions for separator retrofits, capacity upgrades, equipment replacements, and performance optimizations.
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving: Perform root-cause analysis and equipment evaluations to troubleshoot complex performance issues on active job sites and provide effective corrective action plans.
  • Cross-Functional & Mentorship Leadership: Collaborate with global teams across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Field Support while providing technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineering staff.

Education and Experience

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Experience: 8+ years of progressive engineering experience in mechanical design, industrial machinery, or process equipment.
  • Design Capabilities: Demonstrated strength in core mechanical design principles, mechanical drawings, performance calculations, and technical documentation.
  • Project Exposure: Proven experience supporting capital projects, engineered-to-order (ETO) equipment, or heavy aftermarket solutions.
  • Language: Professional working proficiency/fluency in English (spoken and written).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry Experience: direct experience with cement manufacturing equipment, particle separation technology, air classifiers, and grinding circuits (e.g., ball mills, vertical roller mills).
  • Global Exposure: Track record of working effectively within global, cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Additional Languages: Proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

Key Technical & Leadership Competencies

  • Domain Expertise: Advanced understanding of particle separation dynamics, heavy machinery design, structural mechanics, fluid flow, and wear-resistant design principles.
  • Complex Problem Solving: Ability to apply analytical reasoning and root-cause analysis (RCA) to troubleshoot complex mechanical and operational equipment issues.
  • Commercial Orientation: Strong capability to balance high-level technical integrity with cost considerations and customer performance expectations.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, global teams, and external clients.

As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.

Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. title: Time and Leave Clerk
description:
The position is located in the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), at the VA Western Colorado Health Care System, in the Clinical Management Service (Nursing). The primary purpose of the Time and Leave Clerk is to provide timekeeping and other clerical support for the Nursing Service of approximately 225 employees including Associate Chief Nurses and is the primary timekeeper for approximately 9 groups of time and attendance records.

Major duties include but are not limited to: Electronically recording daily time and attendance for ADPCS/Clinical Management (Nursing Service) with different appointments, i.e. GS, Wage Grade, full-time, part-time, or intermittent. This covers all shifts within a 24-hour period, seven days a week, including weekends and holidays. Completion and accuracy of the time and attendance records and for assuring that they are released to Payroll as required by regulation using the VATAS System. At the end of each pay period, is responsible for computerized payroll data entry for all Nursing Service Employees. Maintaining/editing Tour of Duty list for assigned Nursing Service employees. Typical duties would include: Posting includes regular hours or days worked, tour changes as needed, overtime, holiday pay, night differential, compensatory time (CT) earned or taken, Saturday and Sunday premium pay, absence for Leave Without Pay (LWOP), Absence Without Leave (AWOL), Military Leave, 90% Annual and Sick Leave, Authorized Absence (AA) and changes in T&L Units. Posting is made from the Certified Time Schedule. Obtaining proper supervisory approval for all changes made to scheduled tours of duty as well as providing technical advice on tour changes. VATAS Time and Leave Clerk. In conjunction with AcuStaf records all time and attendance for complex schedules for nursing staff to include recording annual leave, sick leave, FMLA, AWOL, comp time, overtime, and call offs to ensure all nursing and administrative staff receive proper pay with verification across both programs Acustaf and VATAS. Checking leave balances of employees to ensure balance is adequate for leave taken. The immediate supervisor is contacted when balances are not adequate for leave authorized or requested. Entering electronic requests for overtime, compensatory time for assigned Nursing Service employees, and responsibility for obtaining proper approvals on such requests. Advising appropriate Nursing Supervisors on a variety of items pertaining to pay plans, tours of duty, timekeeping coding, premium pay, compensatory time, etc. Analyzing time and leave coding errors and processing required corrections in the time and attendance records and obtaining higher level supervisory approvals. Preparation of corrected timecards in the event of errors or when employees have been placed on Continuation of Pay (COP). Typically, they may assure leave exceptions are corrected every period working in collaboration with Nurse Manager and at the end of each pay period, and is responsible for computerized payroll data entry for all Nursing Service employees. Provides routine information to callers, visitors and staff to facilitate the smooth flow of the clerical processes. Assisting and giving guidance to Patient Care Services employees regarding policies and regulations governing the time and leave system. Assists and instructs alternate timekeepers on rules and regulations of timekeeping. Types reports, letters, schedules, and other various materials as needed. Establishes and maintains files in accordance with the Records Control Schedule for historical time keeping information. Performs other related duties as assigned Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm Telework: This position is not authorized for telework. Virtual: This is not a virtual position. title: Child and Youth Program Leader - 2,000 Dollars in Sign-on and Retention Bonuses Available
description:
Incumbent provides appropriate specialized developmental care and instruction for children and youth ranging in age from 6 weeks to 18 years in one or more CY programs. This includes the provision of guidance, assistance, and mentoring for the CY Program Assistants. The incumbent works under the direction of the supervisor or other qualified higher graded employee, who provides guidance on scope of assignments and assistance on the more complex, nonroutine problems encountered.

The Child and Youth Program (CYP) Leader provides direct care and instruction to children and youth (6 weeks to 18 years) in addition to guidance, assistance, and mentoring for CY Program Assistants. Routine day-to-day assignments are normally performed independently with technical assistance available from supervisor when required. Routine assignments are spot-checked; the more technical assignments are closely reviewed for adherence to policies, procedures, and instructions. The duties and responsibilities have been grouped into categories, including mentor, curriculum, indoor and outdoor environment, interactions and relationships, supervision of children and youth, parent and employee communication, assessment, compliance, and additional responsibilities. Each is described below. Mentor Mentors assigned CY Program Assistant team. Works with senior employees to provide instruction and training to lower-level employees. Assists lower-level employees in completing the Standardized Module Training. Assists the Training and Curriculum (T&C) Specialist in helping lower-level CY Program Assistants translate professional development training into practice by mentoring, guiding and role-modeling. Models appropriate behaviors and techniques for working with children and youth. Provides suggestions and makes recommendations to credential practicum candidates. Assists the T&C Specialist with recording observations and charts progress of team members' on-the-job skills. Consults frequently with the T&C Specialist for guidance on strategies to further assist team members' professional development efforts. Curriculum Plans activities for program participants based on observed needs of individual children and youth. Continually reviews activities and plans for appropriateness. Works with T&C Specialist, supervisor, and the CY Program Assistants to implement activities and special events that meet the physical, social, emotional, and cognitive needs of children and youth. Incorporates special instructions provided by parents such as special dietary needs, physical needs, or other information that may affect the child or youth's experience in the program. Prepares and implements program options for children and youth with special requirements. Assists children and youth with special projects, homework, and life skills. Recommends to the T&C Specialist and CY Program Assistants changes and adjustments to activities and plans where necessary to meet unusual situations. Sets up displays and bulletin boards. Arranges for and/or serves appropriate snacks or meals where applicable. Indoor and Outdoor Environment Works with team members to prepare, arrange, and maintain indoor and outdoor activity areas and materials to accommodate daily schedules. Makes suggestions about improvements to the activity areas. Inventories equipment on a recurring basis and recommends replenishing damaged, missing, and depleted supplies. Secures supplies, equipment, and facilities. Interactions and Relationships Encourages participant interest and establishes a program setting that promotes positive interactions with other children, youth, and adults. Interacts with children and youth using approved child guidance and youth development techniques. Supervision of Children and Youth Provides care and supervision, oversight, and accountability for program participants in compliance with the Department of Defense (DoD), NAF Component, and local installation command policies, guidance, and standards. Maintains control of and accounts for the whereabouts and safety of children and youth. Ensures children and youth (as applicable) depart with authorized person according to written parental instructions. Oversees arrival and departure of children and youth. Supervises children and youth during daily schedule of indoor and outdoor activities and on field trips, outings, and special events. Parent and Employee Communication Interacts professionally with employees, parents, and local installation command personnel. Participates in conferences with parents, employees, school representatives, and local installation command personnel. Briefs other employees and parents. Assessment Observes children and youth and documents developmental progression and/or concerns and uses the information in planning. Assists CY Program Assistants with assessment tasks when needed. Compliance Ensures assigned area achieves and maintains standards for DoD certification and national accreditation or equivalent. Ensures compliance with law, policies, and regulations applicable to DoD CY programs. Additional Responsibilities Collects, maintains, and reports program participation data. Performs other related duties as assigned. A complete list of duties and responsibilities will be provided at the time of hire.

title: Project Responsible Engineer

Who will you be working with?

You will work closely with Wabtec’s Product Engineering teams across multiple global sites, including specialists in brakes, safety systems, controls, RAMS, FEA, and validation. You will partner cross-functionally with Project Managers, engineering leaders, and global teams based in Europe and India, while serving as the primary technical interface with customers.

How will you make a difference?

As a member of the Transit Engineering organization, you will serve as the Project Responsible Engineer, acting as the key technical liaison between the customer and Wabtec. You will coordinate engineering activities across multiple product lines, ensuring that all technical requirements are clearly defined, executed, and validated throughout the project lifecycle. This role plays a critical part in delivering high-quality, compliant brake and safety systems by driving alignment across teams, managing requirements, and ensuring successful verification, validation, and homologation. You will also support project execution by identifying and mitigating risks while maintaining a strong customer focus.

What do we want to know about you?

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics Engineering, or related field

  • 4–6 years of experience in engineering project management or similar roles

  • Strong understanding of engineering development processes, including requirements management and V-cycle validation

  • Experience working in customer-facing roles with strong communication skills

  • Proficiency in MS Office and project management tools

  • Experience with requirements traceability tools (e.g., Polarion)

  • Familiarity with CAD tools such as SolidWorks and PLM systems such as Teamcenter is preferred

  • Ability to work in a global environment with cross-functional teams across regions

  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of brake systems and control electronics

  • Experience supporting safety-critical systems and compliance processes

  • Prior experience in rail or transportation industries

What will your typical day look like?

  • Serve as the primary engineering contact for customers, ensuring clear communication and timely issue resolution

  • Coordinate engineering activities across product teams to ensure project alignment and execution

  • Manage and maintain system and subsystem requirements, ensuring proper flow-down and traceability

  • Drive technical quality from development through serial production

  • Plan, execute, and document Verification & Validation (V&V) activities

  • Ensure system performance meets customer contracts, Wabtec standards, and safety requirements

  • Lead brake system homologation and ensure compliance with regulatory and certification requirements

  • Identify and mitigate technical risks while aligning engineering scope with customer expectations

  • Represent engineering within the Project Core Team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders

  • Develop and manage the project engineering plan, including integration, validation, and product delivery

What about the physical demands of the job?

This role primarily involves office-based engineering and coordination work, with potential for occasional travel to customer or project sites. The position requires the ability to communicate effectively, work on a computer for extended periods, and collaborate across global teams.

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable).

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
What you can expect

We're hiring a Product Manager to own Common Room's integrations and data-sync surface. This is the capabilities customers trust with their most critical GTM data. You'll own the product areas that keep customer data complete, current, and reliable.


You'll partner with customers, AEs, CSMs, and a pod of engineers and designers. The work spans 0-to-1 (new integrations, new data surfaces, agent-facing APIs) and 1-to-n (hardening sync reliability so customers trust us and expand). You'll report to our Head of Product and work closely with the founding team.


About the Team


Common Room is the AI GTM Platform that empowers your teams with AI agents built on complete buyer intelligence. We unify signals across the full buyer journey into one continuously-updated, person-level view. Common Room replaces your disconnected stack with one platform built for scale and complexity. We bring together data, orchestration, and execution in one system built for orgs of 75-1000+.


Responsibilities


  • Defining the integrations and platform strategy and roadmap. This is the surface area that determines whether customers trust our data enough to run their GTM on it.
  • Making reliability a product outcome: uptime, data freshness, and accuracy customers never have to think about — and fast, legible triage when something does break.
  • Shipping AI agent workflows and APIs that move real GTM work across customer systems end-to-end: enrichment, sync, signal-to-action — not demos, production.
  • Owning a small set of customer relationships directly, and turn what you learn into product bets the whole company can rally behind. Especially where integrations make or break a renewal.
  • Partnering with engineering and design to make complex capabilities seem simple. Self-serve integration setup a non-technical RevOps lead can actually configure, sync behavior a data team can actually trust.
  • Owning the work through migrations, deprecations, enablement, and the Sales and CS feedback loop that turns features into retained revenue.
  • Raising the bar on product craft across the team — through the work you ship and the way you operate.

What we’re looking for

  • Have 6+ years in product management. (At least one tour owning integrations, data sync, or a platform/API surface for B2B SaaS — CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), sales-engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo), webhooks).
  • Have PM-level fluency with the integration primitives. (OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, and data mapping/object sync) Enough to make the calls and earn engineering's trust without writing the API code yourself.
  • Have a track record of owning reliability as a product outcome, rather than treating it as engineering's problem. (Uptime, freshness, accuracy, error rates, incident triage).
  • Demonstrate real fluency with AI products: you've shipped LLM- or agent-powered features in production. You have opinions about evals and agent design, and you know where the technology genuinely helps versus where it's marketing.
  • Have a first-principles take on what GTM should look like in an AI-agent world. As well as the systems thinking to assess how one decision ripples across data, identity, and downstream syncs and agents.
  • Be comfortable with being the direct responsible individual for customer relationships. Running discovery, sitting in on calls, and translating into specs — and calm as the escalation point when an integration breaks.

title: ERP Applications Analyst - Order to Cash
description:
You will own the day-to-day support, configuration, and continuous improvement of the enterprise applications that power Billing, Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Cash Reconciliation. You will troubleshoot complex incidents and escalations, fulfill change requests, and partner with Finance stakeholders to translate business needs into well-supported application solutions. You will apply AI and automation to modernize finance application support, automating manual processes, reducing ticket volume through self-service and intelligent tooling, and leveraging AI-driven triage, analysis, and reconciliation. You will act as a subject-matter expert on the billing and cash application landscape, support the month-end billing run, monitor integrations with ERP, banks, and payment gateways, write SQL queries to analyze issues, and maintain documentation, SOPs, and knowledge-base articles.

Responsibilities

  • Provide support for billing, O2C, and cash-reconciliation applications, owning complex incidents and escalations
  • Triage, investigate, and resolve application issues within agreed SLAs, performing root-cause analysis
  • Manage the incident, problem, and change lifecycle in the ITSM tool
  • Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to resolve defects and track fixes to closure
  • Support the month-end billing run, monitoring billing jobs and ensuring invoices generate on time
  • Identify and build AI- and automation-driven solutions to reduce manual effort and ticket volume
  • Apply automation (scripting, workflow tools, RPA) to repetitive support, configuration, and reconciliation tasks
  • Leverage AI tooling for intelligent ticket triage, root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and knowledge-base assistance
  • Configure and maintain application settings supporting billing rules, pricing, order workflows, and reconciliation logic
  • Gather requirements from Finance stakeholders and translate them into configuration changes and functional specifications
  • Support testing, deployments, and release cycles including regression testing for patches and upgrades
  • Maintain technical and functional documentation, SOPs, and knowledge-base articles
  • Monitor and support integrations between billing/O2C/cash systems and the ERP, banks, payment gateways, and data warehouse
  • Investigate data and interface failures and drive timely resolution
  • Write and run SQL queries and reports to analyze issues, validate data, and support audit and month-end close activities
  • Act as a trusted point of contact between Enterprise IT and Finance Operations
  • Support compliance, security, and audit requirements including SOX-relevant controls

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 8-12 years of experience supporting enterprise/finance applications, ideally within billing, O2C, AR, or cash-reconciliation domains
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI and/or automation to streamline support, operations, or finance processes
  • Hands-on experience supporting or administering Zuora and NetSuite and the integration between them
  • Strong working knowledge of end-to-end Order-to-Cash processes and supporting systems
  • Experience supporting New Product Introductions (NPIs) in billing and ERP

  • Experience with an ITSM tool and structured incident/problem/change management practices

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Role Overview

The Business Intelligence Analyst enables data-driven decision-making across the organisation by designing, developing, and maintaining data models, dashboards, and reports that translate complex business data into clear, actionable insights. The role works across multiple business domains, including Sales, Product, HR, and Finance, collaborating directly with stakeholders to define requirements, build analytics solutions, and drive adoption of self-service analytics. The role leverages AI-assisted tools as a core part of day-to-day analytical work, using them to accelerate analysis, surface insights, and detect anomalies in business data. This role requires a technically strong analyst with solid SQL and data modelling foundations, a cross-functional mindset, and the curiosity to work effectively across shifting domains and emerging.

Main Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using Microsoft BI technologies, ensuring solutions are accurate, scalable, and aligned to business requirements.

  • Build and maintain data models using best practices, working across cloud and on-premise data sources.

  • Collaborate directly with business stakeholders, analysts, and subject matter experts across Sales, Product, HR, and Finance to gather requirements, provide technical expertise, and deliver analytics solutions that drive business performance.

  • Translate complex business concepts and data into clear, actionable visualisations and insights that stakeholders can use to make informed decisions.

  • Use AI-assisted tools, including LLM-based assistants and AI agents, to accelerate data analysis, insight discovery, and anomaly detection.

  • Act as an advocate for data and analytics across the organisation, driving adoption of self-service analytics and building system-wide analytical capability.

  • Stay current on emerging technologies in analytics and applied AI, making recommendations where relevant to improve the team's tooling and approaches.

Requirements

Required Experience

  • At least 3 years of experience in a business intelligence or data analytics role, with demonstrated ability to deliver complex reporting solutions independently and without close direction across multiple domains.

  • Proven experience solving analytical challenges across multiple business domains, such as Sales, Marketing, Finance, or HR, with the ability to adapt quickly to different priorities and stakeholder contexts.

  • Experience translating business requirements into data models, visualisations, and dashboards that are used and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with or openness to working with AI-assisted analytics tools in day-to-day analytical work.

  • Experience in a SaaS business, including working knowledge of SaaS-specific metrics such as ARR, churn, and retention, is an advantage.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools for analytics, Python for data analysis, or platforms such as Snowflake, dbt, Azure, or BigQuery is an advantage.

Required Skills

  • Strong SQL knowledge and data preparation capability, comfortable working across ETL/ELT processes and structuring data for analysis and reporting.

  • Solid understanding of data modelling principles and the ability to apply them to produce accurate, maintainable analytics solutions.

  • Communicates complex data and analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, able to present insights in a way that drives decisions rather than just reporting numbers.

  • Works effectively across business domains and shifting priorities: picks up new contexts quickly, takes initiative without waiting to be directed, and applies a generalist problem-solving approach to get things done regardless of where the need sits.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Power BI is a strong advantage.

  • Actively engages with emerging analytics technologies and applied AI: keeps pace with a fast-moving tooling landscape and continuously develops new skills as part of the role.

title: Senior Product Manager, Caper Recommendations & Personalization
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Caper is at the forefront of Physical AI, building smart shopping carts that sense and respond to the real world in real time. By bringing intelligence onto the cart, Caper digitizes the entire in-store shopping journey, turning every trip into an interactive, personalized experience from the first item added to checkout. Our plug-and-play technology requires no store renovation or operational overhaul — retailers simply add Caper Carts and instantly upgrade their stores into connected, intelligent shopping environments. Caper is one of the fastest-growing retail automation technology products in the market and is already widely adopted across the industry.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own recommendations and personalization on the Caper Cart. In this role, you will define how the cart decides what to show each shopper, when to show it, and how it adapts to who they are. Every recommendation, moment of inspiration, and ranking decision on the cart screen runs through the systems you will build and refine.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of recommendation systems, machine learning, and a physical shopping experience that unfolds in real time as a customer moves through a store. You will blend ML and data science work with hands-on UX design thinking, partnering closely with Instacart's discovery and personalization platforms while shaping a first-of-its-kind experience for the Caper customer. You will report to the Group Product Manager for Caper Customer Value and work alongside a tight-knit team of three product managers, with broad cross-functional reach across Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations.

About the Job

  • Set and own the vision for recommendations and personalization on Caper. Caper turns the store itself into a personalization surface, where every item added and every step through the store is a chance to show something useful in the moment. You will drive Engagement as a primary pillar metric — growing customer interactions, building monetizable surfaces, and diversifying the content mix to serve savings, discovery, and health-focused shoppers.
  • Own the system that decides what to show and when. Mature recommendation and item ranking using machine learning, including LLM-based techniques, and use real-time signals — cart location and motion, lists, search, and Instacart personalization data — to deliver content at the moments it is most relevant rather than constant or intrusive.
  • Drive AI-first innovation to expand what Caper shows shoppers. Ship net-new content types with nuanced product information and pairings tailored to each individual, and lead the architecture for capturing real-time, in-session signals that make personalization feel genuinely intelligent.
  • Champion a high-quality, intuitive shopping experience by partnering closely with Design to translate complex personalization logic into interactions that feel simple and natural on the cart screen. Spend time in labs and partner stores to observe real shopper behavior, test features, and iterate quickly based on what you learn.
  • Run a fast, experiment-driven roadmap and serve as the product lead for recommendations and personalization across the organization — aligning senior stakeholders on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress, and partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations from discovery through launch with clear PRDs and measurable success criteria.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of product management experience or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience partnering with ML or data science teams to ship models into a production consumer product
  • Experience defining and driving engagement or relevance metrics, and using experimentation to move them
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data and quantitative analysis to make sound decisions in ambiguous environments
  • Track record of close partnership with UX design teams and applying strong design thinking practices throughout the product development process
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting to large groups and aligning multiple senior stakeholders on strategy and tradeoffs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building recommendation, personalization, ranking, or search products
  • Experience with consumer-facing hardware, IoT, or physical retail products
  • Familiarity with retail, grocery, ads, or marketplace recommendation systems

At Engine, we’re transforming business travel into something personalized, rewarding, and simple. Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In’s Best Places to Work.

Your Mission

As part of the Engine team, you'll help drive the growth of our card product, one of the biggest bets in shaping Engine's identity as a Fintech company. This role sits at the forefront of getting customers into the card experience, with a crisp north star that makes winning easy to see. Engine has done the hard work on travel, offering perks that competitors can't match because of our supply side relationships, and this is a product market fit opportunity waiting to be scaled. Here's what you'll take charge of:

  • Own the growth product roadmap for the card: Shape the product experiences that bring customers into the card and get them to first use. Own onboarding, activation flows, in product prompts, and the surfaces that turn interest into adoption.
  • Drive conversion and activation across the funnel: Move the metrics that matter, from first touch through activation and repeat use. Design and ship experiments across the product, learn fast, and compound wins into a repeatable growth motion.
  • Shape the card experience for new and activating customers: Partner with the broader card team to make sure the earliest moments of the product feel great. Identify friction, prioritize the highest leverage fixes, and ship them.
  • Partner with cross functional teams: Work closely with engineering, design, data, and marketing to ship quickly, learn quickly, and hold a high bar for craft.

What You'll Bring to Engine

We're looking for someone ready to shape one of the most consequential bets at Engine:

  • Experience: Minimum 8 years in product management, with a strong track record as a growth or activation PM on consumer or prosumer products. You've owned a funnel through product levers and moved it. Fintech experience, particularly in card products, is a strong plus.

  • Judgment: You have conviction and aren't a pushover. You can tell an engineer or a stakeholder "no" and explain why. You help make hard prioritization calls and stand behind them.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart’s People Analytics & Research (PAR) team delivers trusted insights that help leaders make better, faster decisions and create an environment where every employee can do the best work of their career. Embedded within People Services Delivery, we partner across the People org and the business to build the data infrastructure, dashboards, analytical frameworks and research that power workforce planning, organizational health, and strategic HR initiatives for all Instacart employees. In addition, our mission is to bring these insights to life through close partnerships with partner teams across Instacart.

We’re hiring a Senior People Data Scientist (L5) to serve as an enterprise‑wide people analytics thought partner—blending data engineering, analytics, consulting, and data product ownership. You will own complex, multi‑quarter analytical workstreams, shape company‑level people metrics, and help leaders at all levels use data to make better, more equitable decisions about our workforce.

This is a high‑visibility IC role with significant exposure to senior HR and business leaders, ideal for someone who is equally comfortable in Snowflake, extracting insights from employee data, executive‑level storytelling, and in shaping how HR and business leaders across Instacart use data at scale.

About the Job

  • Help to evolve the enterprise people analytics agenda across key domains (e.g., organizational health, performance, hiring), including cross functional partnerships to align metrics to Instacart’s priorities and providing insights which help solve our more complex people problems.
  • Contribute to high‑stakes, enterprise‑wide projects, such as:
    • Drivers of retention across functions
    • Implementation and analysis of people surveys across Instacart
    • Organizational Health and design metrics
    • Engagement survey insights and action effectiveness
    • Implementation of AI in analysis workflows
  • Design and mature self‑serve people data products (dashboards, standardized views, metric layers) that scale across HR and the business—standardizing definitions, partnering with People Tech and Finance on data architecture, and driving adoption through enablement and training.
  • OwnData Warehousing and Data Architecture design decisions spanning across data ingestion, ETL/ELTs through BI Tools and LLMs.
  • Bring analytical rigor to enterprise People programs (e.g., performance cycles, comp reviews, workforce planning, AES) by defining success metrics, segmenting impact, and recommending changes based on evidence and HRBP‑style judgment about feasibility and change management.
  • Apply and interpret advanced methods where needed, such as predictive attrition models, cohort/survival analysis, and simple causal frameworks to evaluate program effectiveness, while keeping methods transparent and explainable to HR and business audiences.
  • Serve as a partner to HRBPs, People leaders, and analysts on data literacy, metric interpretation, and responsible use of HR data. Contribute meaningfully to the team’s move from ad hoc requests to thought partnership and guidance on the appropriate use of people data for decision making.
  • Champion data governance, privacy, and role‑based access across Workday, Snowflake, BI tools, and Qualtrics, partnering with People Tech and vendors to ensure HR data is accurate, secure, and fit for sensitive people decisions.
  • Contribute to PAR’s roadmap, operating model, and culture—refining intake and prioritization, setting bar‑raising standards for analysis and storytelling.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a closely related field, with at least 2–3+ years in People Analytics / HR data (HCM, recruiting, comp, retention, DEI, engagement, or workforce planning).
  • Experience designing and maintaining executive‑facing dashboards and data products in a BI tool (e.g., OneModel, Tableau, Looker), including metric design, documentation, and stakeholder enablement/training.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience with a modern cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, including working with large, complex datasets, performance‑tuned queries, building data pipelines, and developing analytics-ready models.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear stories and actionable insights for HR/business leaders, including writing talking points and delivering live presentations.
  • Demonstrated expertise in multivariate analysis, including the design and interpretation of regression models, comparison testing, and natural language processing techniques applied to large-scale text data.
  • Strong foundation in research methodology and psychometrics, with the ability to design, validate, and interpret survey instruments and other qualitative measures with rigor.
  • Experience handling sensitive HR data with strong judgment around privacy, security, and role‑based access controls.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or relevant field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in People Analytics or Workforce Analytics teams that moved a function from ad‑hoc reporting to scalable, self‑serve analytics (e.g., standard dashboards, templates, data education programs).
  • Depth with Workday, Greenhouse, OneModel, Qualtrics, or similar tools, including how data flows between systems and how to design analytics‑ready data structures.
  • Experience designing and analyzing employee survey programs (engagement, lifecycle surveys, program evaluation, pulsing), including segmentation and action‑planning support for HRBPs and leaders.
  • Background operating in a fast‑paced, high‑growth, or public‑company environment with multiple senior stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated influence in cross‑functional settings, partnering with HRBPs, Total Rewards, Recruiting, Finance, and People Tech to land complex initiatives with both technical and change‑management components.
  • Availability to work West Coast hours (PT) strongly preferred

Masters degree in a quantitative or relevant field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is scaling its Comparison business, and we’re looking for a best-in-class Senior Product Manager to help drive it forward. This hands-on role will take ownership of the on-site experience and journey funnels for the traffic we buy through Social and Native across every Comparison vertical. You’ll become the go-to person for how we match and convert the customers these channels send us. You’ll build the journey funnels, features and capabilities that maximize conversion, revenue and engagement. Above all, you’ll deliver customers propositions they genuinely value.

Our Comparison business connects customers with the right products across a panel of partners, earning revenue by sending high-intent, well-matched customers their way – so getting the journey right is everything.

You’ll bring the on-site experience for Social and Native traffic to life across every vertical, working alongside functions including Business Development, Marketing (Social and Native), Engineering, Design, Data and the wider Product team. You’ll turn channel insight and commercial opportunity into a clear roadmap, keeping what customers genuinely value at the centre of it.

The person we’re looking for is a genuine all-rounder with a deep understanding of what motivates the customers arriving through Social and Native. You’re a self-starter and an exemplary communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned and reliably delivers what matters most.

Responsibilities:
Proposition, commercials & strategy

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the on-site experience and journeys serving Social and Native traffic across all verticals, aligned to the overall Comparison strategy set by the Product Director. Contribute to the Social and P&L owned by the General Manager, and balance customer needs, partner economics and business goals.
  • Grow and optimize the on-site performance of Social and Native traffic across all verticals – continually improving journeys, propositions and their commercial contribution.

Journeys, funnels & conversion

  • Keep customer value at the heart of every decision – define what great looks like for customers and measure the value your propositions deliver.
  • Own the end-to-end comparison journey for Social and Native customers – from ad click and landing through comparison, selection and hand-off to partners – removing friction at every stage.
  • Build and optimize journey funnels, features and capabilities that maximize conversion, revenue and engagement, working with our Optimization team to test assumptions through experimentation and discovery.
  • Partner closely with Marketing (Social and Native) to align traffic quality and on-site experience across campaigns, audiences and placements, maximizing conversion from every source.
  • Understand how customers behave when they arrive from Social and Native. Use buying-cycle insight, network signals and channel data models to match the right customers to the right partners and maximize the revenue we earn from these sources.
  • Harness AI to create standout customer experiences for Social and Native visitors, from AI-powered calculators and tools to smarter, more personalized journeys that reflect channel intent. Find new ways to help customers decide with confidence.

Requirements & delivery

  • Translate the proposition, commercials and partner arrangements into clear requirements for Engineering.
  • Own a prioritized backlog and work hand-in-hand with Business Development, Marketing, Engineering, Design and Data to deliver from concept to launch and beyond.

Data, tracking & downstream services

  • Understand wider functions and products – including tracking, data, CRM and acquisition marketing – well enough to inform your approach and requirements.
  • Ensure the right tracking and data are in place, then track performance and drive iterative improvements post-launch.

Stakeholder communication

  • Work closely with Business Development to build strong partner relationships, acting as the day-to-day product interface and keeping delivery on track.
  • Act as the central point of communication for your vertical, keeping senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams aligned on shared outcomes.

What you’ll bring:

  • 4+ years in product management, with a track record of delivering high-impact products and journeys that drive conversion and revenue.
  • Experience in comparison, affiliate or lead generation (or a comparable performance-driven vertical), ideally within insurance, health or emerging categories. Comfortable with the commercial, partner and regulatory dynamics.
  • Deep, hands-on experience matching and monetizing customers from Social and Native channels, with a proven track record of driving significant revenue from these sources.
  • Strong grasp of Social and Native buying processes, campaign and audience data models, and the network signals that flow from these channels – and how to turn them into better matching and conversion.
  • A strong track record of growing and optimizing journeys and propositions to move the numbers that matter.
  • Excited by the potential of AI to shape customer experiences – from calculators and tools to new, more personalized journeys – and keen to put it into practice.
  • Exemplary communication and stakeholder skills, with a proven ability to work well with commercial, marketing and third-party partners.
  • Data-driven, curious and proactive – happy to be hands-on in a fast-moving, expanding team.

title: Interior Designer - Workplace (Mission Critical) - Specialized
description:
We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking.

Woolpert is an award-winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting-edge technology to deliver exceptional client value. Our team is passionate about their work and committed to building the next generation of industry leaders, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, Woolpert embraces progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth.

Woolpert is hiring an Interior Designer to join our Interiors Discipline supporting our dynamic Mission Critical / Data Center practice. This position reports to the Interiors Discipline Team Leader and is responsible for assisting with the planning, design, and coordination of interior spaces in the design, planning, and delivery of highly technical workplace interior environments within mission critical and data center facilities.

This role includes developing interior design concepts, producing design documentation and high-quality renderings, and collaborating closely with the architectural team to ensure a fully integrated design approach. The position requires experience in interior systems, materials, detailing, and coordination—particularly where interiors intersect with complex infrastructure, MEP systems, and operational requirements.

You will serve as a trusted technical and design resource, working collaboratively with project managers, architects, designers, and consulting partners to support design quality and successful project outcomes. This role requires the ability to engage effectively with experienced professionals, contribute to integrated architectural and interior design solutions, and communicate clearly through all phases of design and delivery.

This position is ideal for a technically and creatively driven interior designer who thrives in mission critical environments, values collaboration with architectural partners, and is ready to grow as an emerging design leader within the firm.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

What You Will Do:

  • Support specific technical aspects of interior projects, from assessment through coordinated solutions and documentation.
  • Prepare detailed interior design documentation and specifications, supporting coordinated project delivery.
  • Develop and support interior design deliverables, including space planning, finish concepts, and FF&E, while assisting in oversight to ensure design intent and project milestones are met.
  • Create presentation materials to communicate design concepts, options, and recommendations to internal teams and clients (as assigned).
  • Collaborate closely with the interdisciplinary project team, including architects, engineers, and consultants, to coordinate interior scope, resolve design challenges, and support integrated project delivery.
  • Coordinate with project leadership and other disciplines to resolve interior design requirements and maintain alignment across deliverables.

Job Description:

Contribute to the strategic direction of the business and support impactful mission outcomes as a QEHS/Safety Director at GDIT. Here, you’ll enable the success of the most critical government missions and the growth of a meaningful career in QEH/Safety Operations.

QEHS/SAFETY DIRECTOR

Quality, Environmental, Health and Safety (QEHS)

Responsible for planning and coordinating Quality, Environmental, Health and Safety (QEHS) activities with respect to GDIT compliance with Federal, State and Local regulations for the Navy Marine Corp (NMC) Sector. Maintain GDIT Corporate certifications for ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 at the following locations; Chesapeake VA, California, MD, and Pawcatuck CT.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are looking for an experienced quality / safety director to join our company. In this role, you'll be responsible for creating and overseeing quality, health and safety protocols for the Navy and Marine Corps sector, primarily bi-coastal waterfront operations in support of the United States Navy and Marine Corps and ensuring that staff members are properly informed regarding emergency preparedness, use of protective equipment, and accident protocol.

To drive operational success, the Director will champion company health and safety initiatives while ensuring strict compliance with OSHA 29 CFR 1910/1915 standards as well as environmental requirements with hazardous materials/waste, air permitting, and other environmental concerns relating to maritime support. The ideal candidate should excel at rapidly identifying workplace hazards and executing proactive solutions to minimize health risks and prevent incidents.

QUALITY / SAFETY DIRECTOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Developing and implementing workplace safety policies and procedures in accordance with OSHA standards.
  • Providing personnel with safety-related information such as training sessions, emergency protocols, and proper use of safety equipment.
  • Reviewing existing policies and procedures to ensure they are current for both internal practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Overseeing the sector's daily quality, environmental and safety operations and identifying opportunities for improvement of safety regulations.
  • Performing audits and inspections of work areas and jobsites to identify possible quality and safety issues (Shipboard and Facilities).
  • Oversee site personnel physically inspecting all work areas and jobsites to identify possible quality and safety issues.
  • Conducting risk assessments to minimize workplace accidents, occupational illnesses or long-term health hazards.
  • Preparing quarterly quality and safety reports and presenting the information to sector management and company level quality and safety team.
  • Collaborating with management to plan and implement a safety protocol budget.
  • Maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) ISO 9001:2015, and demonstrate expertise in Quality Assurance, NAVSEA Standard Items and QA requirements beyond 009-004, including 9090-310 and related directives. Experience developing and implementing Quality Plans, conducting QA audits, maintaining QMS documentation, and training personnel in QA best practices for shipboard modernization and repair.
  • Manage a cross-functional QEHS organization that includes functional team leaders and subject matter experts across Safety and Environmental (EHS), Quality Assurance (QA), and the Quality Management System (QMS). Responsibilities include ensuring the organization is properly staffed, structured, and resourced to support sector-wide operational needs; providing leadership direction; developing personnel capabilities; and driving efficiency and coordinated execution of safety, quality, and compliance initiatives.

QEHS/QUALITY / SAFETY DIRECTOR REQUIREMENTS:

Proven Management experience dealing with complex work environment

  • At least 15 years’ experience as a Quality or Safety Manager in a complex safety environment.
  • BS degree
  • Thorough understanding of shipboard safety and quality standards associated with shipboard modernization.
  • Experience developing and implementing Quality Plans and Surveillance Plans and Schedules
  • Excellent knowledge of OSHA standards and federal safety legislation.
  • Solid knowledge of potentially hazardous materials or practices in the workplace.
  • Experience developing and leading Corrective Action, Continuous Improvement programs
  • Familiarity with writing health and safety policies and procedures.

title: Site Lead Data & ML
description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Site Lead, Data & ML — London

Why Almedia

Almedia runs Freecash, a rewards platform with ~80 million users, profitable since day one, and currently the #3 fastest-growing company in Europe. We're building out our first dedicated data/ML presence in London, and this is the seat that gets to shape it from the ground up.

This is a rare opportunity to build a team and technical culture from first principles, with real autonomy over how it grows and a direct line between your decisions and the company's results.

The Role

You'll lead our London data/ML function, currently a single hire, growing to roughly 5-10 over the next year. You'll stay hands-on throughout: reviewing code, joining model reviews, and remaining a genuine technical contributor as you build out the team. Your impact will be measured the way ours is, in the results you help drive, not in headcount or process for its own sake.

You'll report directly into our Chief Science Officer and work closely with our CTO.

What You'll Do

  • Own the London data/ML team's roadmap, translating business priorities (reward/payout optimisation, real-time personalisation, offer ranking) into a team structure and technical plan

  • Stay close to the work, reviewing designs and code alongside your team, not just signing off on them

  • Hire, coach, and grow a small, high-ownership team; shape the technical bar and interview process as you scale

  • Partner directly with senior leadership to connect London's work to company-level outcomes

  • Help establish London as a core part of Almedia's technical foundation from day one

What We're Looking For

  • Strong individual-contributor credentials at a senior/staff/principal level; you've built significant things yourself, and want to keep building alongside your team as you lead

  • Deep experience owning a domain end-to-end, such as recommendation systems, marketplaces, adtech, pricing/uplift, or a comparably rigorous applied-ML domain

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a flat structure; you enjoy defining how something should work, not just running a playbook that already exists

  • A track record of connecting technical work directly to business outcomes you can point to

What Excites You

You're drawn to the idea of shaping a team's culture and technical direction from the very beginning, rather than optimising a structure that's already in place. You like staying close to the code even as you take on more leadership, and you're motivated by seeing your work translate directly into business impact.

Compensation and equity for this role are bespoke, reflecting the seniority and scope of what we're building.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Student-Academic Coaching Graduate Assistant
description:
Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

The opportunity

Southern New Hampshire University's Wolak Learning Center (WLC) is seeking an Academic Success Coaching Graduate Assistant to provide in-person academic support for University College students on the Manchester campus. Working closely with the Assistant Director and the part-time Academic Coach, the Graduate Assistant will provide individualized academic coaching through the Academic Recovery Program (ARP), helping students develop the skills and strategies needed to achieve their academic goals.

This position is open to full-time graduate students and is an opportunity for students interested in the field of teaching, higher education, or college student development to learn practical skills in those areas. The Graduate Assistant position can be customized to a student’s interest and background. The Graduate Assistant will have the chance to understand higher education and grow as a student and professional.

The ideal candidates will have exceptional organizational, interpersonal and leadership skills; oral and written communication skills; adaptability and flexibility; and student leadership experience. Candidates must be able to work independently, collaborate with the WLC team regularly, and be willing to jump in and take on additional projects as needed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Engage in relationship-based student coaching to support the growth of transferable learning, organizational, and executive function skills through one-to-one meetings.

  • Positively impact retention and success of campus students by providing exceptional student support and foster engaging learning experiences.

  • Develop a strong understanding of university supports and resources and refer students to appropriate resources as needed.

  • Maintain confidentiality of all student records and information shared during coaching sessions.

  • Collaborate with faculty and staff to coordinate and support efforts and advocate for student needs.

  • Assist in the development and implementation of coaching programs designed for students on academic probation.

  • Supervise peer educators during evening hours, as necessary.

  • Provide tutoring services as needed.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Represent Wolak Learning Center at on-campus recruitment events

  • Build relationships with students, as well as SNHU staff and faculty, to enhance student success

  • Participate in weekly staff meetings focused on student retention

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Full-time enrollment in a graduate degree program at SNHU

  • Bachelor’s degree in preferred relevant field

  • Must have a 3.00 or above undergraduate cumulative GPA

  • Submit Cover Letter and Resume for consideration

  • Strong knowledge of MS Office that supports office processes

Preferred Qualifications:

  • At least one year of mentoring, coaching and/or tutoring experience in higher education

  • Classroom experience as a teacher, student teacher and/or teaching assistant

  • Familiarity with SNHU policies and procedures, and experience with Brightspace or similar online learning platform

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel

Learning Outcomes:

  • As a result of working in the Wolak Learning Center, the Academic Coaching graduate assistant will develop skills to assist students in specific content areas using multiple in-person modalities and develop specific differentiated coaching strategies to meet various needs of learners based on learner preferences, strengths/weaknesses, background, or prior knowledge.

  • As a result of working in the Wolak Learning Center, the Academic Coaching graduate assistant will develop leadership skills through coaching students, collaborating with WLC staff, and assisting the Assistant Director and Part-Time Academic Coach with other individualized projects to further the mission of the Wolak Learning Center.

  • As a result of working in the Wolak Learning Center, the Academic Coaching graduate assistant will be able to explain, demonstrate, and incorporate study habits, motivation, and academic success strategies consistent with those emphasized during coaching training.

  • As a result of working in the Wolak Learning Center, the Academic Coaching graduate assistant will incorporate effective communication skills into coaching sessions and improve his/her own professional development skills for post-SNHU employment opportunities.

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

Compensation

The hourly pay range for this position is $13.00 - $15.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations.
