title: Health Research Fellow (Temporary Remote in U.S.)
description:
HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

As a temporary Health Research Fellow, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping advance the goals of the Innovation & Research team at USGBC. In this role, you’ll support a defined, time-bound project to compile and synthesize the latest trends and developments in health-related building strategies, and develop, test, and refine the trend scanning process in alignment with our mission and strategic goals. This fellowship is designed for a strong researcher and synthesizer; it does not require deep technical consulting expertise.

This is a temporary, project-based fellowship engagement. This is not a regular employee position and is not eligible for employee benefits. Compensation is based on completion of agreed-upon project milestones and deliverables.

You’ll report to the Project Manager, Senior Associate of Innovation & Research and be part of a collaborativeteam environment where your contributions will help shape impactful outcomes. You’ll work closely with teams like Innovation & Research and may regularly partner with Technical Development to gather relevant insights and maintain alignment on cross-team objectives.

You will also :

  • Gain hands-on experience working on meaningful initiatives
  • Develop professional and technical skills
  • Partner with experienced professionals across teams

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct a structured review of research and industry resources (e.g. scientific journal articles, briefs and reports, presentations, news) published within the last ten years on health-related building strategies, utilizing USGBC research compilation infrastructure (inSIGHT tool).
  • Categorize supporting evidence to feed into USGBC’s inSIGHT tool, including consistent tagging aligned to team topics of interest and labeling resources by type and rigor of evidence to support different internal use cases.
  • Test and assess the USGBC inSIGHT tool workflow for consistency and quality, identify gaps, issues, and practical improvements, and refine the configuration of the tool to optimize performance.
  • Revise a short standard operating procedure (SOP) for the information-gathering process based on your assessment and refinement of the inSIGHT tool workflow.
  • Synthesize research review findings into an internal memo on the status of current supporting evidence and trends of importance related to health-promoting building design, highlighting 1) what is well evidenced and what needs further research, and 2) emerging trends of the past decade.
  • Provide related synthesis and updates as needed, for recurring check-ins on progress and final deliverable takeaways.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • Prior internships, research projects, volunteer work, or relevant coursework that included qualitative research activities and substantial writing experience in green building, environmental health, environmental science, public health, or similar.
  • Interest and prior research experience in topics related to green buildings, environmental health, environmental science, public health, or other relevant fields.
  • Completion of relevant coursework and/or work experience in qualitative and quantitative research methods and summarizing technical findings in writing is particularly important.

Education

  • Graduate-level education (completed or currently enrolled) OR equivalent professional experience in relevant areas of practice (including green buildings, environmental health, environmental science, public health, or other relevant fields) and conducting applied research/literature reviews and producing written synthesis.

Technology/System(s)

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office programs
  • Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence tools

Skills

  • Analytical and critical thinking
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Organization and time management
  • Research and data interpretation
  • Collaboration and adaptability

LOGISTICS

Compensation:Compensation will be provided in lump sum installments upon completion of deliverable milestones, not to exceed $10,000 total compensation. Full timeline and cadence will be determined with the candidate, with the expectation that all deliverables will be finalized within 3 months at the latest. If you have vacation scheduled where you will be absent for more than 5 days, we discourage you from applying.

Location: This position is remote in the United States.

Work Schedule:

This is a part-time, time-bound fellowship; schedule will be set with the supervisor to meet deliverable timelines. Candidates will be expected to be available to meet with supervisor once a week at minimum during normal working hours within Eastern Standard Time Zone. Note: Consultants are not compensated for holidays or personal time off.

ABOUT US

The U.S. Green Building Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) is a mission-driven nonprofit dedicated to accelerating and scaling the transformation of the built environment. Through LEED—the world’s most widely used green building rating system— and initiatives likes Greenbuild, the Center for Green Schools and advocacy, USGBC empowers professionals to drive market transformation that advances human and environmental health, climate resilience, and equity.

We are proud to be globally recognized for our leadership in green building, environmental performance, and sustainable development.

Our Global Impact

  • Over 120,000 LEED-certified commercial projects worldwide
  • Millions of square feet of certified healthy, efficient, low-carbon space
  • Recognition in 180+ countries for innovation in green building and business practices

Why Join Us?

At USGBC and GBCI, you’ll work alongside passionate, mission-aligned professionals who care deeply about people, the planet, and progress. We offer:

  • A purpose-driven, inclusive culture
  • Opportunities to grow your career and take ownership of meaningful work
  • A chance to make a measurable impact on global sustainability efforts
  • We’re seeking team members who thrive in collaborative environments, are committed to excellence, and want to build lasting partnerships that drive change in the built environment.

Meet Our Leaders and Learn More about our Mission:

  • U.S. Green Building Council Leaders
  • Green Business Certification Inc Leaders

Culture and Values Statement

Working together, each of us advances our mission by respecting all voices, trusting and supporting one another, excelling through collaboration and accountability, and continuously improving ourselves and our organization.

title: TOR FOR CONSULTANCY SERVICES FOR THE DESIGN, DELIVERY AND INSTITUTIONALISATION OF A LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME FOR MID & SENIOR MANAGERS
description:
Background

SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia (SOSCVE) is a non-governmental, non-political, non-denominational charitable child welfare organization. For the past more than 50 years, we have been working to build families for children in need, help them shape their future, and share in the development of their communities.

Everything we do is based on the best interest of the child. We help vulnerable families care for their children, and we work to prevent the breakdown of parental care. When children lose parental care (the care of families of origin), we provide quality alternative care in different care settings according to the children’s best interests. We support young people in their efforts to become independent adults and succeed in life.

We collaborate with donors, communities, governments, and other organizations to reach the children who need support when emergencies strike; we focus on providing humanitarian assistance, care, and protection for children and families in coordination with the government and other relief agencies. We continuously measure the impact of our program.

For more than five decades, SOS CVE has been designing various interventions to support vulnerable children and youth in Ethiopia. With its midterm plan and strategy for 2030, the organization is striving to reach many more Children and Youth with its programs.

Rationale for the assignment As part of its refreshed strategy, SOS CVE is investing in strengthening organisational effectiveness by aligning talent with its strategic priorities. A key pillar of this agenda is leadership development—building a strong internal leadership pipeline, accelerating localisation, and enhancing the managerial and strategic capabilities of leaders across program and functional areas. While leadership development initiatives have been implemented over the years, these efforts have largely been ad-hoc and fragmented. The organization therefore seeks to establish a structured, scalable, and institutionalised leadership development program that can be sustainably owned and delivered internally.

Accordingly, SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia invites sealed technical and financial proposals from qualified and legally registered consultancy firms, higher learning institutions, or consortiums—whether based in Ethiopia or internationally—with demonstrated expertise in leadership development, organisational development, and capacity building to design, deliver, and institutionalise a Leadership Development Program for Mid- and Senior-Level Managers.

OBJECTIVE OF THE ASSIGNMENT

To institutionalise a structured leadership development framework that strengthens leadership capability across mid-level and senior management, and to leave SOS CVE with the internal capability, materials and ownership required to continue delivering the programme without further external support.

Scope of services

The assignment covers the following activities:

Leadership standard and pathway design

  • Review the organisation's strategy, competency architecture, People and culture policy and internal leadership diagnostic finding
  • Define a reasonable number of behaviourally specific leadership standards; indicatively four to six — with observable behavioural anchors at mid-level and senior level, rather than a comprehensive competency inventory
  • Design a structured learning pathway for each leadership level, weighted towards development through experience and exposure and reinforced by formal learning
  • Align the standards with the organisation's succession planning and talent management processes

Curriculum and programme development

  • Develop a competency-based, modular curriculum with facilitator guides, participant materials, case studies and digital learning content, contextualized to the Ethiopian and East African non-governmental sector
  • Address leadership mindset and identity alongside technical and behavioural skills
  • Design action learning projects capable of being applied to live organisational challenges nominated by the Senior Leadership Team

Cohort delivery

  • Deliver four workshop modules to two cohorts (senior managers and mid-level managers, indicatively five participants each) over approximately six months, co-facilitated with SOS CVE internal leaders
  • Provide structured coaching and mentoring support across the delivery period
  • Support the organisation in tracking participation, learning and application

Assessment, evaluation and institutionalisation

  • Design and administer a baseline multi-rater capability assessment before the first module, and a comparable endline assessment at the close of the programme
  • Provide a monitoring and evaluation framework covering reaction, learning, behaviour and results
  • Transfer full ownership of all curriculum and materials to SOS CVE in editable source
  • Certify not at least two SOS CVE employees as competent to deliver the full programme independently.

The transfer of all materials in editable source form and the certification of at least two internal facilitators are contractual conditions of final payment and are not negotiable.

Deliverables

  • Inception report and detailed work plan
  • Leadership standard with behavioural anchors, and the leadership pathway per level
  • Full programme curriculum, facilitator guides, participant materials and digital content
  • Baseline assessment instrument, administration and cohort baseline report
  • Delivery of four modules to two cohorts, with coaching and action learning support
  • Certification of at least two SOS CVE internal facilitators
  • Endline assessment, comparison report and monitoring and evaluation report
  • Complete handover of all materials, source files and data to SOS CVE

Ethical standards and fraud prevention

SOS Children's Villages Ethiopia applies a zero-tolerance policy to fraud, corruption, coercion, collusion and sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. The organisation does not charge any fee at any stage of a procurement or recruitment process, does not operate through agents or intermediaries, and will never request a payment in connection with a tender.

  • Bidders, their personnel and their subcontractors must not offer any inducement, gift or facilitation payment to any person connected with SOS CVE. Any such offer will result in disqualification and may be reported to the relevant authorities and to other organisations in the sector.
  • SOS CVE is committed to fair and transparent competition and encourages proposals from firms led by or substantially employing women, and from Ethiopian and regional firms, consistent with its localisation commitments

Reservation of rights

SOS Children's Villages Ethiopia reserves the right to: accept or reject any proposal in whole or in part; annul the tender process at any stage without incurring liability; extend the deadline for submission; request clarification or additional documents from any bidder; conduct due diligence and reference checks; negotiate scope and price with the highest-scoring bidder; award the assignment in separate lots; and decline to award at all. No bidder acquires any right to the award by reason of submitting a proposal, and SOS CVE is not obliged to give reasons for its decision beyond those required by law or by its own policies.Intellectual Property Rights

All reports, documents, training materials, manuals, presentations, datasets, software, designs, methodologies, and any other work products developed, produced, or generated by the consultant/service provider under this assignment shall become the sole and exclusive property of SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia upon completion of the assignment and full payment, unless otherwise agreed in writing.Safeguarding Commitment for consultants

At SOS Children's Villages Ethiopia, safeguarding is at the heart of everything we do. It is a fundamental value that guides our actions, decisions, and relationships. We are firmly committed to protecting the children, young people, adults, and communities we serve, as well as our workforce, assets, and resources.

We foster a culture of trust, respect, accountability, and transparency, where every individual's voice is valued and heard. All successful bidders, contractors, consultants, and service providers are required to adhere to our safeguarding standards and principles, including compliance with our Child and Youth Safeguarding Policy, Code of Conduct, Sexual Misconduct Regulation and Anti-Corruption Regulation and any other form of unethical conduct.

Successful contractors are expected to integrate these standards into all aspects of their work and service delivery, ensuring the highest levels of safety, professionalism, ethical conduct, and integrity at all times.

title: Manual Press Break Operator
description:
Simpson Strong-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.

Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.

Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

YOU

As the Manual Press Brake Operator, you will be responsible for punching, bending, seating, flanging, and top flanging material to the specifications contained within work orders and production drawings in such a manner as to achieve safety, quality, efficiency, lean and production goals. Work independently and take initiatives to meet production deadlines and KPI’s.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

The Manual press brake operator is responsible for bending, seating, flanging, and top flanging material to the specifications contained within work orders and production drawings in such a manner as to achieve safety, quality, efficiency, lean and production goals. Work independently and take initiatives to meet production deadlines and KPI’s. (70%)

Set up machine for required operation (bending, flanging, seating, top flanging) and manufacture parts according to prints and work orders. (15%)

Perform quality inspections to drawings and specifications per procedures and communicate with department leadership regarding issues and improvements. (10%)

Material handling between different machines (5%)

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

If you can do everything listed above, you’ve got what it takes. Perhaps some of the following would be helpful too:

  • High School Diploma
  • Manufacturing production experience (2 years)
  • Sit down forklift certification (or ability to be certified)
  • Understanding how to read a tape measure, protractor, and square.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, see, talk and hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. This role operates large equipment while standing for approximately 8-12 hours, regularly twisting and bending in a repetitive motion. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may frequently lift, carry, push and pull materials and objects weighing up to 50 pounds, and heavier weights with proper equipment.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The job may risk exposure to heat and/or cold, loud noise levels, vibration, and moving mechanical parts.

TRAVEL REQUIRED

This job does not require travel.

WORK STATUS & LOCATION

This full-time, non-exempt, position is located in Stockton, CA. It is not eligible for remote work. This is a Swing shift position (3:30pm – 12:00am)

RELOCATION

Relocation is not available for this position.

PAY

$18.00 / hour


REWARDS AT SIMPSON STRONG-TIE

We recognize and reward employees with a carefully designed and comprehensive rewards package, including competitive compensation, quarterly bonuses or commission and first-rate benefits. May exclude some positions, such as seasonal jobs.

  • Quarterly Bonuses/Commission: You will be eligible for either a bonus or commission, paid on a quarterly basis. We believe all employees affect customers, sales and revenue — directly or indirectly – and should be rewarded by sharing the company profits.
  • Benefits: We provide a wide range of benefits for eligible full-time employees including: medical, dental, vision, retirement contributions, employee stock purchase and bonus plans, pay for holidays, vacation, sick days, funerals and jury duty, years of service awards, employee discounts, employee referral bonuses, charitable contribution matching, education reimbursement and more. title: Senior Technical Level Designer
description:
Lingokids is on a mission to help families raise amazing kids through Playlearning™. Ready to join us on this exciting journey? 🚀

We’re an entertainment company behind the world’s leading interactive app for kids aged 2–8, designed to spark curiosity, creativity, and joy every single day.

Enjoyed by over 20 million families each month, it offers more than 4000 interactive games, songs, and shows loved by kids and trusted by grown-ups around the world. Created by parents and educators, it stands as the ultimate destination for kids fun without compromise. Designed to be ad-free and age-appropriate, Lingokids delivers a premium, handcrafted experience that’s KidSAFE certified, with learning by default.

More than 200 million downloads worldwide and over 50 awards have established Lingokids as the standard for kids entertainment.

As a Senior Technical Level Designer, you'll join Level Design team, building engaging games and interactive experiences that delight children and resonate with parents across markets and languages; championing fun, intuitive play while pushing the boundaries of educational entertainment.

If you want to be part of a team that's redefining the future of education, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll do

  • Own Technical Design Projects across departments, maintaining and building processes that ensure we can keep growing and scaling our catalog while serving the overall Level Design team’s needs.

  • Work alongside Engineering to help building the frameworks for new experiences looking to balance technical resilience, scalability and designer usability.

  • Develop and maintain in-depth technical design documentation, and communicate technical requirements for assets across teams.

  • Ensure technical optimization of games and promote quality standards and best practices for asset implementation within the team.

  • Design and produce layouts, levels, parameters, and features for our games inside the Unity Editor, following set guidelines.

  • Mentor, inspire, and support a team of junior and mid-level designers in their day-to-day work and professional growth.

  • Collaborate with Production to plan game releases aligned with company goals.

  • Lead level design efforts within the app localization project, ensuring games and interactive experiences work seamlessly across markets, languages, and cultural contexts.

  • Drive retention and engagement by collecting qualitative feedback from user tests with kids (ages 2–8) and quantitative data from metrics, then translating insights into design decisions.

  • Assist in prototyping simple game experiences using internal tools.

What you’ll bring

  • 4+ years as a Level Designer or Technical Game Designer, ideally in mobile or educational gaming.

  • Proven experience designing and shipping games or interactive experiences in Unity.

  • Proficiency in Unity Editor for level design, feature configuration, and game parameters.

  • Strong understanding of technical optimization practices in Unity.

  • Experience writing and maintaining in-depth design documentation and specifications.

  • Solid grasp of interaction design, game mechanics, player motivation, and level design principles.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines (production, UX, art, engineering).

  • High-quality standards and attention to detail in gameplay polish.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with children's digital content or products for young audiences (2–8 years old).

  • Familiarity with scripting logic or visual scripting tools.

English is a must:We’re a multicultural team providing a service in English, so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective spoken and written communication—especially in asynchronous, long-form formats—is key to collaborating successfully.

Life at Lingokids

📚 Career Growth: Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to €2,000 per year for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.

🏡 Remote- Friendly in Spain : Work from wherever you’re most productive, whether that’s your home anywhere in Spain or our vibrant hub in Madrid.

📈 Stock Options: Your contribution matters! You'll receive stock options, giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.

🖥 Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a €400 allowance for setup and €35/month for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity!

🍲 Meal Allowances: Get €60/month on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better!

💳 Flexible Compensation: Manage your meal, transport and childcare expenses easily with Cobee, integrating them directly into your payroll.

🩺 Health Insurance: Access private health coverage at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple.

💬 Language Lessons: Learning never stops! Enjoy free language classes in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team.

🌍 Visa Sponsorship: If you need a visa to work in the EU, we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless.

🎉 Company events: Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites!

Passion matters more than perfection

Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Lingokids, diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role
We're looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our team.


You'll be at the forefront of designing, developing, and deploying AI systems that power personalised advertising, customer journey analytics, audience segmentation, and real-time bidding strategies.

Working closely with BI, data engineers, and product teams, you'll help build scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes for some of the world's most recognised brands. Our infrastructure is powered by Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and we take pride in applying cutting-edge AI techniques to real-world marketing and advertising challenges.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Multi-Agent Design: Design, build, and deploy scalable multi-agent systems and generative AI features for Mar Tech challenges including ad targeting, user segmentation, and content personalisation.

  • Advanced Agentic Workflows: Research and implement agentic design patterns such as planning, reflection, and tool usage using orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI.

  • Performance & Guardrails: Monitor and optimise multi-agent systems in production, tracking agent-specific metrics including token efficiency, execution loops, and tool-calling accuracy to ensure system reliability.

  • Security & Compliance: Maintain high standards for data security, model explainability, and mitigation of agent-specific risks such as prompt injection and unintended tool execution in compliance with GDPR and CCPA.

  • Mentorship & Best Practices: Support and develop junior engineers and help champion best practices in agent-oriented programming, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and scalable cloud infrastructure.

About You

  • Experienced in software engineering, ideally in Ad Tech, Mar Tech, or similarly complex and high-scale environments

  • Experience building multi-agent or single-agent architecture with integrations to APIs and/or MCPs

  • A good understanding of supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning methods alongside experience working with foundation models and prompt engineering

  • Practical experience with GCP services or AWS equivalent such as Vertex AI, BigQuery ML, Dataflow, AI Platform Pipelines, and Dataproc

  • Practical experience with CI/CD for AI/ML, model versioning, monitoring, and AI Ops practices

  • An understanding of marketing and advertising concepts such as customer lifetime value, attribution modelling, real-time bidding, and audience targeting is a plus

  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow and Kubernetes is a plus

  • You do your best work as part of a team and enjoy sharing knowledge just as much as gaining it

  • Confident navigating ambiguity and a fast moving environment

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Collaborative and grounded, you value the perspectives of others and create space for everyone to contribute

What You’ll Get

  • Travel Insurance

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Annual Company Conference

  • Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

  • Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

Job Description:

QEHS/SAFETY DIRECTOR

Contribute to the strategic direction of the business and support impactful mission outcomes as a QEHS/Safety Director at GDIT. Here, you’ll enable the success of the most critical government missions and the growth of a meaningful career in QEH/Safety Operations.

QEHS/SAFETY DIRECTOR

Quality, Environmental, Health and Safety (QEHS)

Responsible for planning and coordinating Quality, Environmental, Health and Safety (QEHS) activities with respect to GDIT compliance with Federal, State and Local regulations for the Navy Marine Corp (NMC) Sector. Maintain GDIT Corporate certifications for ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 at the following locations; Chesapeake VA, California, MD, and Pawcatuck CT.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are looking for an experienced quality / safety director to join our company. In this role, you'll be responsible for creating and overseeing quality, health and safety protocols for the Navy and Marine Corps sector, primarily bi-coastal waterfront operations in support of the United States Navy and Marine Corps and ensuring that staff members are properly informed regarding emergency preparedness, use of protective equipment, and accident protocol.

To drive operational success, the Director will champion company health and safety initiatives while ensuring strict compliance with OSHA 29 CFR 1910/1915 standards as well as environmental requirements with hazardous materials/waste, air permitting, and other environmental concerns relating to maritime support. The ideal candidate should excel at rapidly identifying workplace hazards and executing proactive solutions to minimize health risks and prevent incidents.

QUALITY / SAFETY DIRECTOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Developing and implementing workplace safety policies and procedures in accordance with OSHA standards.
  • Providing personnel with safety-related information such as training sessions, emergency protocols, and proper use of safety equipment.
  • Reviewing existing policies and procedures to ensure they are current for both internal practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Overseeing the sector's daily quality, environmental and safety operations and identifying opportunities for improvement of safety regulations.
  • Performing audits and inspections of work areas and jobsites to identify possible quality and safety issues (Shipboard and Facilities).
  • Oversee site personnel physically inspecting all work areas and jobsites to identify possible quality and safety issues.
  • Conducting risk assessments to minimize workplace accidents, occupational illnesses or long-term health hazards.
  • Preparing quarterly quality and safety reports and presenting the information to sector management and company level quality and safety team.
  • Collaborating with management to plan and implement a safety protocol budget.
  • Maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) ISO 9001:2015, and demonstrate expertise in Quality Assurance, NAVSEA Standard Items and QA requirements beyond 009-004, including 9090-310 and related directives. title: Data Analyst
description:

About 4th Wheel Social Impact

4th Wheel is a purpose-driven consulting firm specializing in Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) to create meaningful social impact. We empower organizations to measure and enhance their outcomes across various sectors through high-quality, data-driven insights. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to join our dynamic team and contribute to the success of our impactful projects.

About The Role

We are seeking a Data Analyst with strong experience in managing data, building structures, and using advanced analytical tools to generate insights. Proficiency in Excel, SPSS, or R is essential. You will manage large datasets, design dashboards, and support diverse project analysis needs while ensuring accuracy and consistency across our social impact consulting assignments.


Requirements

Data Management & Analysis

  • Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights for clients and internal projects
  • Develop and maintain robust data structures to ensure data integrity and consistency across all datasets
  • Perform statistical analysis using tools like SPSS, R, or Excel to identify trends, patterns, and key insights

Dashboard Creation & Reporting

  • Design and develop interactive dashboards to visually present key data insights for clients and internal teams
  • Create regular data reports that highlight important metrics, trends, and areas for improvement
  • Develop and implement KPIs to track project success, profitability, and client satisfaction

Collaboration & Support

  • Work closely with project managers and M&E specialists to understand data needs and ensure timely and accurate delivery of analysis
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide data-driven recommendations for improving project efficiency and outcomes
  • Act as a point of contact for any data-related queries, providing timely resolutions and insights

Data Quality Assurance

  • Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and validity of data entered and analyzed across all projects
  • Continuously improve data collection and analysis processes to enhance overall project quality
  • Perform regular audits on data processes to ensure compliance with internal standards

Qualifications
​Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field.

Experience

2+ years of experience working with large datasets, data analysis, and reporting.

Technical Skills
  • Proficient in Excel for data analysis, pivot tables, and advanced formulas.
  • Experience with SPSS or R for statistical analysis.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, etc.) to create interactive dashboards.
  • Knowledge of data structures and how to organize and manage data for large-scale analysis.
  • Strong understanding of statistical analysis methods and how to apply them to social data.
Aptitude
  • Problem-Solving:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

  • Communication:

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data findings in a clear and accessible way to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

Ability to maintain accuracy while managing and analyzing large volumes

  • Sector Experience:

Experience in the social sector or with M&E projects is a plus, though not mandatory


Benefits

Why Join 4th Wheel?

At 4th Wheel, we value innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Joining our team offers the opportunity to work on impactful projects that drive social change, while advancing your career in a supportive and dynamic environment.

title: SDET Analyst I
description:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best-in-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.

Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a SDET Analyst I to join our ever evolving Quality Engineering team and help shape the future of global commerce. In this role, you’ll help build quality into every stage of the software development lifecycle, ensuring the solutions that power millions of transactions are reliable, secure and scalable. Working alongside developers, analysts and technology partners, you’ll contribute to automation strategies that accelerate delivery, strengthen performance and enhance the client experience. This is an opportunity to grow your technical expertise, influence engineering excellence and play a meaningful role in advancing Global Payments’ mission to deliver innovative payment solutions that connect businesses and customers around the world.

  • Improve application performance and resilience by contributing to performance, load and security testing initiatives that enhance system stability and protect the client experience.
  • Advance engineering efficiency by leveraging continuous integration (CI) tools, automation and quality metrics to enable informed decision-making and support continuous improvement across the development lifecycle.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Information Systems or another technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Foundational knowledge of software development and quality engineering principles, with an interest in building automated testing and quality solutions.

  • Exposure to programming or scripting languages such as Java, Python, C#, SQL or similar technologies used to support software quality and automation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and collaboration skills, with the ability to learn quickly, adapt to new technologies and contribute effectively within a team environment.

It's a bonus if you have

  • Experience developing or supporting automated testing frameworks, strategies or continuous integration environments.
  • Exposure to application programming interfaces (APIs), RESTful services or end-to-end test automation in modern software environments.
  • Advanced degree in Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

PNC is one of the largest U.S. banks with $562 billion in assets and $421 billion in deposits. PNC has approximately 56,000 employees across the United States and abroad; approximately 2,300 branches; and approximately 60,000 PNC and Partner ATMs Coast to Coast.

Real Estate Banking is a department within the PNC Real Estate. PNC Real Estate, a part of PNC’s Corporate & Institutional Banking (C&IB) Division, has a national presence with approximately 1,000 employees in 40 cities.

title: Security Operations Center Operator
description:
You will monitor security systems and maintain awareness of incidents that may affect protected personnel, assets, facilities, and information. You will coordinate emergency responses, dispatch security staff, document incidents, support secure client movements, assist with personnel deployments and asset accountability, and serve as a central communication hub. You will also conduct patrols, assist with operational tasks, and participate in ongoing security training and evaluation.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor global security and political incidents that may affect operations or protected personnel.
  • Operate and monitor CCTV, access control, alarm, intrusion detection, and fire alarm systems.
  • Answer phone calls and monitor critical systems.
  • Initiate and coordinate fire, medical, and security emergency-response protocols.
  • Escalate incidents to supervisors and relevant stakeholders.
  • Dispatch security staff as appropriate.
  • Maintain incident reports, daily logs, and shift summaries.
  • Document and investigate security events and incidents.
  • Coordinate secure client movements through itinerary tracking, geo-fence monitoring, threat analysis, and communication with executive protection personnel and drivers.
  • Assist with deployment of security personnel and manage personnel activities across protected locations.
  • Issue equipment and maintain asset accountability.
  • Maintain communications with staff, guests, vendors, emergency services, and employees through radio, telephone, email, and in person.
  • Assist with driving, advances, vehicle fleet operations, vendors, contractors, and client-directed personal tasks.
  • Conduct static and roving patrols.
  • Participate in training and evaluation in combatives, deescalation, weapons proficiency, emergency medicine, driving, and surveillance detection.

Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • At least 4 years of experience in a high-security environment.
  • Familiarity with security operating procedures and incident command structures.
  • Written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with CCTV, intrusion detection systems, access control systems, communications platforms, and Google Workspace.
  • Valid state driver's license or ability to obtain one.
  • Current CPR, First Aid, and AED certification.
  • Colorado residency and a valid concealed carry permit.
  • Residence within a 30-minute drive of the Colorado headquarters in Longmont, Colorado.
  • Proficiency with a Glock 19, M4 rifle, M500 shotgun, or equivalent.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods, run short distances, drag an unconscious adult, perform CPR, and lift at least 50 pounds.
  • Availability for nights, weekends, holidays, and shift backfill as required.

Benefits

  • Medical coverage for the employee and dependents.
  • Dental coverage.
  • Vision coverage.
  • Paid time off.
  • 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Week-on, week-off rotation with 10-hour shifts.

title: Senior Solution Engineer, Networking
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

The NVIDIA Enterprise Experience (NVEX) Solutions Engineering team is looking for a senior Computer or Software Engineer. This person will establish expertise in ground-breaking network technology used in AI clusters. Our software engineers connect customer support teams and R&D. They focus on solving tough problems from the front lines. They provide top support for high-speed interconnect technologies like InfiniBand, NVLink, and Spectrum-X that link GPUs and AI compute infrastructure. Candidates must have a software development background in the networking industry either for a network hardware manufacturer or software integrator. It is essential to have a proven grasp of in-field, production network operations and have experience in root-causing customer-found issues down to the source code level, primarily C and Python. Breadth of experience is key. We want to see experience in multiple areas such as network operating systems (NOS), Linux network drivers and internals, network hardware, NIC software, Smart NICs, DPUs, embedded firmware, Software Defined Networking, and infrastructure management technologies. IPC, race conditions, finite state machines, event processing loops, queue management, network traffic and flow analysis, and software design gaps will be common areas of focus. The individual will get to work across many NVIDIA teams and often interact with both internal and external customers, so superb interpersonal and communication skills are essential. Candidates will need to understand, root cause, and resolve complex issues, and provide detailed explanations of what you find.

What you will be doing:

  • Assist various network and AI cluster support teams in reproducing, resolving, and root causing sophisticated customer issues

  • Work with R&D teams to develop bug fixes, workarounds, and solutions for critical customers using NVIDIA’s network technologies

  • Become an authority in NVIDIA network technologies used in AI clusters such as Infiniband, NVLink, and Spectrum-X

  • Analyze network performance metrics and make tuning recommendations for high-performance, lossless networks

  • Develop support and analysis tools to help analyze and root cause field issues

  • Daily use of ground breaking AI tools for software development, log and trace analysis, and source code debugging

  • Occasional work on weekends or holidays to support customers

What we need to see:

  • Minimum of a BS in Computer, Electrical, or Software Engineering (or equivalent experience)

  • 8+ years of experience in C programming in Linux and embedded systems

  • Proficiency in Python

  • 8+ years of experience developing software for one or more of the following:

  • Linux NIC drivers, switch ASICs and SDKs, embedded network device firmware, Linux based network equipment (routers, switches, gateways, etc), network operating systems, virtual routers, SDN stacks, virtual switching, DPDK, SRIOV stacks

  • At least 3 years of experience directly supporting end-customers, partners, or integrators for network equipment and infrastructures

  • Strong system software (firmware, BIOS, kernel, driver, operating system) expertise

  • Professional-level communication skills, including adjusting communication to the technical level of the audience, and staying calm and focused in negative situations.

  • Passion for learning innovative tech and motivation to work hard on ground-breaking products

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Background with AI infrastructure and HPC networking

  • Experience programming switch and NIC ASICs and SDKs

  • Experience with Infiniband or other non-Ethernet network technologies

  • Experience developing or supporting DPUs or SmartNICs

  • Knowledge of HPC performance test tools and NVIDIA AI stacks (NCCL, MPI, DOCA, CUDA)

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 270,250 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 11, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

title: Manufacturing Technician II
description:
A career at Resilience is more than just a job – it’s an opportunity to change the future.

Resilience is a technology-focused biomanufacturing company that’s changing the way medicine is made. We’re building a sustainable network of high-tech, end-to-end manufacturing solutions to better withstand disruptive events, serve scientific discovery, and reach those in need.

For more information, please visit

Brief Job Description

Day shift position 2-2-3 schedule, 6am to 630pm

This position requires working in various Controlled/Non-Classified areas. The Manufacturing Technician II operates equipment such as parts washers and autoclave, inspects, cleans, and sterilizes equipment, assembles/disassembles equipment, performs area cleanings in accordance with cleaning schedule, and completes batch record entries.

Job Responsibilities (Including Key Result Areas, Specific Accountabilities, Tasks, Etc.)

• Perform the duties of operating assigned machinery consisting of parts washers and autoclaves, etc.

• Responsible for assembling, disassembling, wrapping, operating, and rinsing/sanitizing various equipment.

• Perform set-up activities including but not limited to cleaning/stocking of area, spraying items through airlock, setting up parts wash and autoclave loads per SOP/Form.

• Perform cleaning and housekeeping activities for assigned areas as required to maintain a cGMP environment.

• Perform visual inspections of equipment for cleanliness as specified per SOP. Must obtain visual inspection training certification.

• Obtain knowledge to be able to print off SOP’s/Forms via ECMS.

• Perform batch record and GMP documentation entries. Maintain records and/or logs as required in the performance of job responsibilities. This will include mathematical computation where needed.

• Knowledge of product security controls and material handling equipment.

• Become aseptically qualified to enter the aseptic core area to unload autoclaves and component processing.

• Responsible for outgoing quality level.

• Obtain a novice to intermediate level of knowledge of SAP inventory movements and inventory management such as moving items from one storage location to another and goods issuing items to process orders as required.

• Perform work requirements in a responsible manner, in accordance with SOPs, cGMPs and established safety procedures in accordance with OSHA requirements and guidelines. Be familiar with “Material Safety Data Sheets” for area chemicals.

• Be familiar with job-related safety procedures and hazards including PPEs, ergonomics, LOTO, human safety, material handling, waste handling, chemical handling, and spill controls. Report all discrepancies to process facilitator.

• Assist mechanical staff with preventive maintenance procedures, as required.

• Ability to use material handling equipment such as walk behind or Walkie Stacker.

• Must obtain lift truck certification.

• Support lean activities by participating in 5S and other process improvement activities.

• Identify and provide suggestions for process improvement while maintaining quality and cGMP compliance as opportunities arise.

• Be flexible in training and supporting other functional areas as needed.

• Perform all other assigned duties with minimal supervision under the direction of the process facilitator or designee as needed.

• Send out pass down communications as required.

• May be required to become media qualified to assist with production activities in other functional areas.

• May be required to obtain cold room training/access to be able to transfer materials in and out of the cold rooms.

• May be required to take proper training to become certified trainer within the area.

Education, Qualifications, Skills, and Experience

Minimum Requirements

• Must have the ability to effectively understand, read, write, communicate, and follow instructions in the English language

• Good attention to detail is required. Individual must be capable of keeping accurate records and performing mathematical calculations

Preferred Background

• High school graduate, vocational school graduate or equivalent

• Experience in a pharmaceutical or cGMP regulated environment

• Prior production experience

• Experience working in a LEAN manufacturing environment

• Knowledge of cGMPs and FDA policies/procedures

title: Director, Site Management & Monitoring
description:
Job Title: Director, Site Management & Monitoring

Job Location: Seoul, Korea, Korea, Republic of

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Purpose of the Job

The Director Site Management & Monitoring (DSMM) is accountable for delivering the committed part of all clinical interventional studies under their supervision according to agreed resources, budget and timelines complying with AZ Procedural Documents, international guidelines such as ICH-GCP as well as relevant local regulations.

The DSMM is responsible for line managing dedicated group(s) of staff and responsible for planning and utilization of staff resources, assigned budget, objective setting and performance follow-up.

Typical Accountabilities

  • Leadership of dedicated group, building the team spirit, developing team style and behaviour.
  • Ensures adequate resources for the studies assigned.
  • Ensures that the workload of direct reports is adequate.
  • Development and performance management of direct reports.
  • Ensures that direct reports have development and training plans, according to IDP process.
  • Coaches the direct reports on a regular basis, and plans/organises coaching with external providers if needed.
  • Prepares salary and bonus proposals for direct reports based on their performance in close collaboration with responsible (Senior) Director, Country Head and local HRBP.
  • Contributes to efficient SMM organisation and its functioning at country level by working closely with responsible (Senior) Director, Country Head.
  • Contributes to high quality feasibility work.
  • Oversees successful delivery of SMM study delivery country level targets to plan, with speed and quality.
  • Contributes to the quality improvement of the study processes and other procedures.
  • Ensures all systems are continuously updated.
  • Ensures completeness and timeliness of the eTMF to maintain it “Inspection Ready”.
  • Assists (Senior) Director, Country Head or Local Study ADs/ Local Study Teams in forecasting study timelines, resources, recruitment, study materials and drugs.
  • Provides direction to LSAD/ Local Study Teams on major study commitments including resolving any key issues identified.
  • Supports SMM region in initiatives/activities as agreed with (Senior) Director, Country Head.
  • Ensures collaboration with local Medical Affairs team.
  • Ensures that study activities at country level comply with local policies and code of ethics.
  • Reviews SQV reports of direct reports in line with AZ SOPs
  • Reviews Accompanied site visits/co- monitoring visits/training visits/QC visits performed to direct reports in line with the local QC plans.
  • Performs accompanied site visits according to local QC Plan, supporting ongoing coaching and development.

Functional Capabilities (that are most critical to this position)

  • Very good knowledge of the Clinical Study Process and international ICH-GCP guidelines.
  • Excellent team building skills also in cross-functional teams.

Essential Qualification

  • Bachelor degree in related discipline, preferably in life science, or equivalent qualification (*).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Development Operations (CRA / SrCRA / LSAD) or other related fields.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Manage change with a positive approach for self, team and business. Sees change as an opportunity to improve performance and add value to business.
  • Proven project management experience.
  • Excellent organisational, analytical, influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, verbal and written.
  • Excellent knowledge of spoken and written English.
  • Good ability to learn and to adapt to work with IT systems.
  • Ability for national and international travel.

Desired skills or requirements

  • Line management experience.
  • Very good knowledge of the Clinical Study Process and international ICH-GCP guidelines.
  • Excellent knowledge of the Monitoring Process.
  • Good understanding of the Study Drug Handling Process and the Data Management Process.
  • Good knowledge of relevant local and international regulations.
  • Good medical knowledge and ability to learn relevant AZ Therapeutic Areas.
  • Ability to deliver quality according to the requested standards.
  • Ability to look for and champion more efficient and effective methods/processes of delivering quality clinical trials with reduced budget and in less time.
  • Ability to work in an environment of remote collaborators.
  • Integrity and high ethical standards.
  • Good resource management skills.
  • Excellent decision-making skills.
  • Good financial management skills.
  • Good conflict management skills and ability to handle crisis.
  • Good interviewing skills – responsibility for attracting, developing and retaining personnel.
  • Excellent team building skills also in cross-functional teams.
  • Good intercultural awareness.
  • Excellent ability to work according to global standards.
